Mickie James is an American professional wrestler who has made a significant impact on the world of professional wrestling. Born as Mickie Laree James on August 31, 1979, in Montpelier, Virginia, she discovered her passion for wrestling at a young age. She began training to become a professional wrestler and made her debut in the wrestling world in 1999. Since then, she has become a prominent figure in the industry, showcasing her skills not only in the ring but also as a musician and actress.  
  
James began her wrestling career in various independent promotions before earning a contract with World Wrestling Entertainment (WWE). She made her WWE debut in 2005 and quickly rose to prominence as a skilled athlete with a charismatic personality. Throughout her career in WWE, she achieved numerous accolades, including multiple Women's Championship reigns. Her performances in the ring and ability to connect with audiences established her as one of the top female wrestlers of her generation.  
  
One of James' most notable moments in WWE came in 2006 when she engaged in a memorable feud with WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus. Their rivalry culminated in a highly acclaimed match at WrestleMania 22, where James emerged victorious, solidifying her status as a top-tier competitor. Her dynamic in-ring style and captivating presence made her a fan favorite and a role model for aspiring female wrestlers.  
  
In addition to her success in WWE, James also competed in other wrestling promotions, such as Total Nonstop Action (TNA) and Ring of Honor (ROH). Her versatility as a wrestler allowed her to adapt to different styles and showcase her talent in various promotions around the world. James' dedication to her craft and ability to deliver compelling performances earned her respect from both fans and fellow wrestlers.  
  
Outside of wrestling, James pursued other creative endeavors, including music and acting. She released her debut album, "Strangers & Angels," in 2010, showcasing her talents as a country music artist. Her passion for music allowed her to explore a different artistic outlet while continuing to thrive in the wrestling industry. Additionally, James has made appearances in television and film, further demonstrating her range as a multi-talented performer.  
  
James' impact on women's wrestling extends beyond her in-ring accomplishments. As a trailblazer for female athletes in a male-dominated industry, she has inspired a new generation of female wrestlers to pursue their dreams. Her resilience, determination, and unwavering commitment to her craft serve as a testament to her enduring legacy in professional wrestling.  
  
In recent years, James has continued to make appearances in various wrestling promotions, including a return to WWE in 2021. Her enduring popularity and unwavering passion for wrestling have solidified her status as a revered figure in the industry. Whether she is captivating audiences with her athletic prowess in the ring or captivating them with her music, Mickie James continues to leave an indelible mark on the world of professional wrestling. Her contributions to the sport and her impact on future generations of female wrestlers ensure that her legacy will endure for years to come.

About Benjamin Mays

Benjamin Mays was an influential American minister, educator, and civil rights leader who played a pivotal role in the struggle for racial equality in the United States. Born in 1894 in the segregated town of Epworth, South Carolina, Mays faced numerous obstacles in his pursuit of an education and a career in the ministry. Despite the challenges he faced, Mays went on to become a prominent figure in the fight for civil rights and social justice, leaving behind a lasting legacy that continues to inspire and empower countless individuals today.  
  
Mays' dedication to education and his unwavering commitment to equality were evident from an early age. After completing his undergraduate studies at Bates College in Maine, Mays went on to pursue a master's degree in theology from the University of Chicago. He later earned a doctorate in theology from the university, becoming the first African American to receive a Ph.D. from the institution. These academic achievements were no small feat, particularly for a young man of color in the early 20th century, yet Mays remained undeterred in his pursuit of knowledge and advancement.  
  
Following his studies, Mays embarked on a career in the ministry, serving as a pastor in various communities throughout the United States. His time in the ministry provided him with a platform to advocate for social change and to speak out against the injustices of segregation and discrimination. Mays' eloquence and impassioned sermons drew the attention of many, and he soon became a respected voice in the fight for civil rights.  
  
Mays' most notable contribution to the civil rights movement came during his tenure as president of Morehouse College, a historically black men's college in Atlanta, Georgia. As president, Mays worked tirelessly to expand educational opportunities for black students and to foster a culture of academic excellence and social consciousness. Under his leadership, Morehouse became a hub for civil rights activism, producing some of the movement's most influential leaders, including Martin Luther King Jr.  
  
Throughout his career, Mays maintained a steadfast commitment to nonviolent protest and peaceful resistance, principles that he instilled in the students of Morehouse and the broader civil rights movement. His wisdom and guidance helped shape the strategies and tactics employed by activists during some of the most tumultuous and dangerous periods of the movement, and his influence on the development of civil rights leaders like Martin Luther King Jr. cannot be overstated.  
  
Mays' impact extended far beyond the boundaries of Morehouse College. As an influential speaker and writer, he brought his message of justice and equality to audiences across the country, inspiring countless individuals to join the fight for civil rights. His efforts to promote equality also earned him recognition and accolades from numerous organizations, including the NAACP, which awarded him the prestigious Spingarn Medal for his contributions to the advancement of African Americans.  
  
In addition to his work in education and civil rights, Mays also made significant contributions to the field of theology, drawing on his own experiences as an African American man to offer new perspectives on the Christian faith. His writings and speeches on the intersection of religion and race continue to resonate with scholars and theologians today, sparking important conversations about the role of faith in the pursuit of social justice.  
  
Despite facing numerous challenges and setbacks throughout his life, Mays remained dedicated to his mission of promoting equality and justice for all. His legacy as a pioneering minister, educator, and civil rights leader continues to inspire future generations to work towards a more just and equitable society. Benjamin Mays' unwavering commitment to the fight for civil rights and his lasting impact on the social and educational landscape of America make him an enduring figure in the history of the struggle for equality.

About Deloitte Danmark

Hos Deloitte hjælper vi dig og din virksomhed med alt fra at holde styr på bilag og regnskaber til at gøre din virksomhed mere effektiv, tjene flere penge, ekspandere og blive global. Vi hjælper offentlige myndigheder med analyser og udvikling. Hos Deloitte sætter vi en ære i at lytte til dig og tage udgangspunkt i dine udfordringer, hvad enten du er direktør for en verdensomspændende virksomhed, CFO, bestyrelsesformand, intern revisor, helt nystartet iværksætter, repræsentant for det offentlige - eller noget helt andet. Gennem fælles sparring når vi den bedste løsning.  
  
For os handler revision og rådgivning ikke kun om tal. Egentlig handler det mere om menneskene bag, både hos vores kunder og hos os. Derfor sørger vi for, at alle Deloittes medarbejdere konstant dygtiggør sig gennem teoretisk viden og praktisk erfaring. Vi arbejder inden for mange forskellige fagområder. Men vi har en fælles entusiasme, nysgerrighed og kvalitetssans.  
  
Deloitte er Danmarks største revisionsfirma og rådgivningsfirma. Med 19 kontorer i Danmark og Grønland er vores dygtige revisorer, skatterådgivere og konsulenter lige i nærheden af dig. Skulle du få brug for internationale specialister, trækker vi på alle vores kolleger i Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, der har 210.000 medarbejdere på kontorer i mere end 150 lande.

The university is renowned for its innovative approach to education, emphasizing hands-on experiences that prepare students to tackle some of society's most pressing challenges.  
  
ETSU serves a wide range of industries, including healthcare, education, technology, and the arts, equipping students with the skills necessary to thrive in today's dynamic job market. The university's health sciences programs are particularly notable, providing students with cutting-edge training in fields such as nursing, pharmacy, and public health. In addition, ETSU's digital media and technology programs leverage the latest advancements in technology, preparing graduates for careers in an increasingly digital world.  
  
Beyond academics, ETSU fosters a vibrant campus community where personalized attention is paramount. Students benefit from a supportive environment that encourages community engagement and collaboration. The university's commitment to student well-being is evident in its approachable faculty and staff, who prioritize building meaningful relationships with students. From open office hours with the university president to safety officers ready to assist with everyday challenges, ETSU embodies a welcoming atmosphere that feels like home. With a focus on both academic rigor and community connection, East Tennessee State University is dedicated to shaping the leaders of tomorrow while making a positive impact on the world.

By leveraging his skills in proposal writing, public speaking, and facilitation, Tracy has successfully mobilized resources and support for CJP's initiatives.

His passion for higher education and public policy is reflected in his ongoing engagement with students and emerging leaders, fostering a new generation of advocates committed to justice reform. Through his multifaceted approach, Tracy Siska continues to drive meaningful change, ensuring that the voices of those affected by the justice system are heard and that systemic transparency becomes a reality in Chicago and beyond.

Customers can contact Aesop Auto Parts through their website's contact form, by phone, or via email. Their customer service team is available to assist with inquiries related to orders, product information, and any other questions you may have. They strive to respond promptly to all inquiries.

About Optimal Blue
------------------

Optimal Blue, a division of Black Knight, operates the mortgage industry’s digital marketplace. This Marketplace Platform connects lenders, investors and vendors with comprehensive secondary marketing solutions, market-leading capabilities and value-added services that deliver results. At the center of our marketplace is a common repository of searchable and actionable loan programs and loan-level price data that is leveraged in real time by more than 250,000 users, 3,700 lenders and 225 investors. Our robust loan analytics, lock desk workflow, and pipeline risk management functionalities enable lenders to instantly determine and act on the “true best execution” for all quoting, locking and delivery channels. Additionally, our extensive library of application programming interfaces (APIs) enables automated data exchange between the digital marketplace and the systems used by lenders for lead generation, marketing and loan origination. Optimal Blue prices and locks 40% of U.S. mortgages, provides services to 62% of the top 50 lenders, supports $2.1 trillion of rate locks and processes more than 500 million rate searches annually. We also support $1.4 trillion in loan trades and facilitate $3.5 trillion in transactions every year.

Preferred Home Care of New York, founded in 2010 by Berry Weiss, is a leading provider of home health services in the New York City metropolitan area. The company offers a comprehensive range of services designed to meet the diverse needs of its clients. These include skilled nursing, personal care assistance, physical therapy, and companionship services, all tailored to enhance the quality of life for patients in the comfort of their own homes. Preferred Home Care is fully licensed by the New York State Department of Health and accredited by The Joint Commission, ensuring that it adheres to the highest standards of care and safety.  
  
In addition to its exceptional services, Preferred Home Care employs advanced technologies to streamline care delivery and improve patient outcomes. The use of electronic health records (EHR) and telehealth solutions allows for efficient communication between caregivers and healthcare providers, ensuring that clients receive timely and coordinated care. With a strong focus on patient-centered care and a commitment to continuous improvement, Preferred Home Care of New York remains dedicated to enhancing the lives of those it serves, making it a cornerstone of home health services in the region.

About Chronicled
----------------

Chronicled is a technology company based in San Francisco, CA. We enable automation, trust, and automatic settlement for transactions between companies in the Life Sciences industry. Every year, $500 billion in pharmaceutical medication is dispensed to patients in the US. Behind that industry revenue, intra-company transactions like chargebacks, rebates, and other administrative fees drive distribution and incentives between companies. Chronicled offers solutions powered by the blockchain-based MediLedger Network to automatically settle these transactions, thereby eliminating manual processing, revenue leakage, and cash flow delays experienced across the industry.  
  
Chronicled's first industry revenue management solution, Contracts & Chargebacks, automatically settles chargeback claims between pharmaceutical manufacturers, distributors, and group purchasing organizations to ensuring drug pricing accuracy for healthcare providers, pharmacies, and other dispensers.

What types of digital media solutions does Pulselive offer?

Pulselive specializes in a wide range of digital media solutions tailored for the sports industry. Our offerings include digital design services, sports websites, and mobile applications that enhance fan engagement. How does Pulselive support sports organizations in data visualization?

Pulselive provides advanced data visualization services that help sports organizations make sense of complex data sets. By transforming raw data into interactive and easy-to-understand visual formats, we enable teams, leagues, and broadcasters to enhance their storytelling, improve fan engagement, and make informed decisions based on real-time analytics.

Can Pulselive assist with native mobile app development for sports teams?

Yes, Pulselive has extensive experience in native mobile app development specifically for sports teams and organizations. We create customized mobile applications that provide fans with real-time updates, live scores, and exclusive content. Our apps are designed to enhance the overall fan experience and drive engagement through features like push notifications and social media integration.

What industries does Pulselive primarily serve?

Pulselive primarily serves the sports industry, including professional sports teams, leagues, broadcasters, and sports federations. Our technology solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of these organizations, helping them to engage with fans, manage content, and leverage data effectively to enhance their operations and visibility.

How does Pulselive ensure equal access to sports content?

At Pulselive, we are committed to promoting equal access to sports content through our innovative digital platforms. We focus on creating inclusive and accessible solutions that cater to diverse audiences, ensuring that fans from all backgrounds can enjoy and engage with sports content seamlessly, whether through websites, mobile apps, or social media channels.

What role does social media play in Pulselive's services?

Social media is a crucial component of Pulselive's services, as it serves as a vital channel for fan engagement and content distribution. We integrate social media strategies into our digital platforms, allowing sports organizations to connect with their fans in real-time, share updates, and promote events. About Molecular Templates
-------------------------

Molecular Templates, Inc. (MTEM) is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery and development of biologic therapeutics for the treatment of cancer and other serious diseases. The company primarily develops a pipeline of therapies through its proprietary biologic engineered toxin body (ETB) drug platform with unique mechanisms of actions which are highly differentiated from antibody drug conjugates (ADCs). MTEM is developing MT-6402, which is in a Phase I clinical trial for PD-1/PD-L1 antibody relapsed/refractory patients; MT-5111, which is in a Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of HER2-positive cancers; and MT-0169, which is in a Phase I clinical trial to treat relapsed/refractory myeloma. MTEM’s pipeline of ETBs in development for other targets include CTLA-4, TIGIT, TROP2, and BCMA. MTEM has a collaboration agreement with Bristol Myers Squibb to discover and develop novel products containing ETBs directed to multiple targets. Molecular Templates, Inc. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas. It also has an office in New York, NY.

### Frequently Asked Questions about Pearl Family Dentistry

What types of dental services does Pearl Family Dentistry offer?

Pearl Family Dentistry offers a comprehensive range of dental services to meet the needs of patients of all ages. Our specialties include routine exams and cleanings, fillings, crowns, bridges, dentures, root canals, extractions, implants, bonding, veneers, and wisdom teeth removal. We also utilize advanced technology such as digital X-rays to provide accurate diagnoses and effective treatment plans.

How often should I schedule dental exams and cleanings?

It is generally recommended to schedule dental exams and cleanings every six months. Regular visits help maintain oral health by allowing our dentists to detect any potential issues early and provide necessary treatments. However, some patients may require more frequent visits based on their individual oral health needs, which can be discussed during your appointment.

What should I expect during my first visit to Pearl Family Dentistry?

During your first visit, you will undergo a comprehensive dental examination, which may include digital X-rays to assess your oral health. Our team will review your medical history, discuss any concerns you may have, and develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to your needs. We strive to create a comfortable and welcoming environment to ensure you feel at ease during your visit.

Are dental implants a good option for replacing missing teeth?

Yes, dental implants are an excellent option for replacing missing teeth. They provide a permanent solution that looks and functions like natural teeth. Implants are surgically placed into the jawbone, providing a strong foundation for crowns or bridges. Our experienced team at Pearl Family Dentistry will evaluate your oral health and determine if you are a suitable candidate for implants.

What are the benefits of digital X-rays compared to traditional X-rays?

Digital X-rays offer several advantages over traditional X-rays. They provide clearer images with enhanced detail, allowing for more accurate diagnoses. Digital X-rays also expose patients to significantly less radiation, making them a safer option. Additionally, the images can be viewed instantly, enabling quicker treatment planning and improved patient education.

What should I do if I experience a dental emergency?

If you experience a dental emergency, such as a severe toothache, a knocked-out tooth, or a broken filling, it is important to contact Pearl Family Dentistry as soon as possible. We prioritize emergency cases and will do our best to accommodate you for prompt treatment. In the meantime, you can manage pain with over-the-counter medications and apply a cold compress to reduce swelling until you receive professional care.

About Queen Mary University of London
-------------------------------------

Queen Mary University of London is a world-leading research-intensive university with over 32,000 students representing more than 170 nationalities.  
  
A member of the prestigious Russell Group, we work across the humanities and social sciences, medicine and dentistry, and science and engineering, with inspirational teaching directly informed by our research.  
  
In the most recent exercise that rated research in the UK, we were ranked 7th in the country for the proportion of research outputs that were world-leading or internationally excellent. We offer more than 240 degree programmes and our reputation for excellent teaching was rewarded with a silver in the 2017 Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) awards.  
  
Queen Mary’s history dates back to 1785, with the foundation of the London Hospital Medical College. Our history also encompasses the establishment of the People’s Palace in 1887, which brought accessible education, culture and recreation to the East End of London. We also have roots in Westfield College, one of the first colleges to provide higher education to women.

About Manu Chakravarthy

Manu Chakravarthy, MD, PhD, serves as a Clinical Assistant Professor of Medicine at Rutgers New Jersey Medical School, where he combines his extensive expertise in endocrinology with a commitment to medical education. With over 20 years of experience as a physician-scientist, Dr. Chakravarthy is dedicated to advancing the understanding and treatment of complex human diseases, particularly those with unmet medical needs. His role involves teaching medical students, residents, and endocrine fellows, where he emphasizes the importance of translational research and the integration of clinical practice with scientific inquiry.  
  
At Rutgers, Dr. Chakravarthy also attends the outpatient Lipid Clinic, where he applies his knowledge in diabetes management and lipid disorders to improve patient outcomes. His clinical insights are complemented by his leadership in research and development at Carmot Therapeutics, Inc., a biotechnology company renowned for its innovative drug discovery platform. Here, he focuses on drug development and the identification of biomarkers that can facilitate clinical trials aimed at addressing critical health challenges.  
  
Dr. Chakravarthy's expertise spans a range of areas, including drug discovery, cell biology, and the life sciences, making him a pivotal figure in bridging the gap between laboratory research and clinical application. His work not only contributes to the advancement of therapeutic options but also inspires the next generation of healthcare professionals to pursue excellence in both research and patient care. Through his dual roles in academia and industry, Dr. Chakravarthy exemplifies the integration of scientific innovation with clinical practice, fostering a holistic approach to medicine that is essential in today's rapidly evolving healthcare landscape.

About Axcella
-------------

Axcella is a clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering a new approach to treat complex diseases using endogenous metabolic modulator (EMM) compositions. The company’s product candidates are comprised of EMMs and derivatives that are engineered in distinct combinations and ratios to reset multiple biological pathways, improve cellular energetics, and restore homeostasis. Axcella’s pipeline includes lead therapeutic candidates in Phase 2 development for the reduction in risk of overt hepatic encephalopathy (OHE) recurrence, the treatment of Long COVID, and the treatment of non-alcoholic steatohepatitis (NASH). The company’s unique model allows for the evaluation of its EMM compositions through non-IND clinical studies or IND clinical trials. For more information, please visit www.axcellatx.com.

About Cetera Financial Group
----------------------------

An at-scale wealth hub, Cetera Financial Group® (Cetera) offers financial professionals and institutions the latest solutions, support, and services. Breaking away from a commoditized and homogenous IBD model, Cetera instead creatively addresses advisors' and institutions' unique needs, whether they are seeking to grow, scale, or transition with a merger, sale, investment, or succession plan. Cetera proudly serves independent financial advisors, tax professionals, licensed administrators, large enterprises, as well as institutions, such as banks and credit unions, providing an established and repeatable blueprint for scalable growth.  
  
Cetera's approach empowers advisors to affiliate in whichever way they deem most appropriate. During the professional life cycle of their practice, the Cetera wealth hub helps to ensure each advisor's affiliation model identifies and ignites growth levers in a way that helps increase the value of their practice, people, and legacy. Cetera delivers holistic, unbiased financial planning and advice to Main Street investors, helping them achieve their version of financial wellbeing at all life stages. For financial professionals, Cetera provides growth and succession resources, an enhanced advisor tech stack and importantly, an experience where financial professionals don't feel like a number, but an integral part of Cetera's rich and thriving ecosystem.  
  
Home to more than 8,000 financial professionals and their teams, Cetera oversees approximately $322 billion in assets under administration and $115 billion in assets under management, as of December 31, 2022. In a recent advisor satisfaction survey of more than 14,000 reviews, Cetera's Voice of Customer (VoC) program vigorously measures advisor experience and satisfaction 24/7. Currently, it's ranked 4.7 out of 5 stars.

About Emery Federal Credit Union
--------------------------------

Emery Federal Credit Union is a full service financial cooperative, dedicated to serving its Members. We’re a fast growing, progressive Credit Union that offers Members a full range of banking products and services, including deposit accounts, loan products/services, and commercial services.  
  
What is a Credit Union?  
Emery Federal Credit Union is a not-for-profit, Member-owned financial institution. Unlike banks, thrifts, and finance companies who operate on a “for profit” basis, we return excess earnings back to our Members in the form of lower loan interest rates, higher yield savings and investment accounts, and low or no fee convenience services in addition to the friendly, unmatched Member service we provide.  
  
As a not-for profit financial cooperative, we are dedicated to treating every Member as a part-owner in the Credit Union... because in reality you are. You can enjoy the benefits of the most competitive financial services you’ll find with the reassurance of knowing that your money is safe and secure by being Federally Insured through the National Credit Union Administration (NCUA).  
  
History of Emery FCU  
Emery Federal Credit Union was originally chartered in 1939 to serve Emery Industries. In 1984, we began to expand our field of membership to include other diverse groups.  
  
Since that time, we have grown an astounding 163% and offer four branch locations throughout the tri-state region. We are proud to serve the employees (and their family members) of over 350 companies.

Adam Fangman serves as the Assistant Golf Professional at Boone County Golf Courses, where he leverages his extensive background in golf course management and operations to enhance the overall golfing experience for players of all ages. His dedication to youth development in the sport is underscored by his recognition as a US Kids Top 50 Kids Coach in 2020 and 2021, and as a Top 50 Master Kids Coach in 2022.  
  
In his role, Adam is responsible for managing the Pro Shop operations, ensuring that inventory is well-maintained and that customers receive exceptional service. His expertise in online marketing and sales strategies has been instrumental in promoting events and driving participation in junior golf leagues. Adam's commitment to fostering a love for golf among young players has earned him the PGA Jr League Gamechanger Award for four consecutive years, highlighting his impact on the community.  
  
In addition to his work at Boone County Golf Courses, Adam is also a medical device account executive, where he applies his skills in sales and time management to navigate the complexities of the healthcare industry. His diverse experience, from golf course operations to medical device sales, equips him with a unique perspective that enhances his coaching and instructional methods. Adam Fangman is not only a passionate advocate for the game of golf but also a dedicated professional committed to nurturing the next generation of golfers in Kentucky.

SBI, The Growth Advisory, headquartered in Dallas, Texas, is dedicated to empowering innovative companies to achieve unprecedented growth in revenue, margin, and enterprise value. With a focus on real-world applicability, SBI transcends traditional consulting by providing actionable insights and execution strategies that yield immediate and sustainable results. Unlike conventional advisors who often deliver theoretical slideware, SBI’s team comprises seasoned professionals who have successfully led marketing and sales initiatives at some of the world’s most successful growth companies.  
  
SBI specializes in Go-to-Market Growth Advisory, offering tailored solutions across various industries, including technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and professional services. Their comprehensive suite of services encompasses market strategy development, sales optimization, and customer engagement, all underpinned by a deep understanding of the buyer-seller journey. By leveraging relevant data and proven tactics, SBI helps clients navigate the complexities of their markets and implement strategies that drive significant outcomes.  
  
What sets SBI apart is their collaborative approach; they act as an extension of your team, working alongside you to craft and execute practical strategies that are designed to deliver results not just for the next quarter, but for years to come. By integrating advanced technologies and analytics into their methodologies, SBI ensures that clients are equipped with the tools necessary to adapt and thrive in an ever-evolving business landscape. With SBI, organizations can expect a partnership that fosters growth through innovation, experience, and a commitment to excellence.

What services does SBI Growth Advisory offer to help businesses increase revenue?

How does SBI assist companies in improving their customer experience?

SBI focuses on Customer Experience as a key area for growth. The firm conducts in-depth assessments to identify gaps in the customer journey and provides actionable recommendations to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty. This includes strategies for Customer Success and tailored approaches to engage customers effectively throughout their lifecycle.

What industries does SBI Growth Advisory support?

SBI Growth Advisory works with a diverse range of industries, including technology, healthcare, financial services, and manufacturing. Their expertise in various sectors allows them to tailor solutions that meet the unique challenges and opportunities faced by businesses in these fields, ensuring that clients receive relevant and impactful strategies.

Can SBI help with pricing and packaging strategies?

By analyzing market trends and customer behavior, SBI helps clients develop pricing strategies that maximize revenue while remaining competitive in their respective markets.

SBI employs a comprehensive approach to developing sales strategies, which includes assessing the current sales process, identifying target markets, and aligning sales efforts with overall business goals. Their methodology combines quantitative analysis with qualitative insights, ensuring that the sales strategy is not only effective but also sustainable over the long term.

How does SBI support businesses in talent acquisition for go-to-market teams?

SBI offers GTM Talent solutions to help businesses identify and recruit top talent for their go-to-market teams. As the National Communications Manager at Make-A-Wish America, Casey Thompson plays a pivotal role in shaping the organization’s narrative and enhancing its visibility through strategic media engagement and storytelling. With a robust background in both the non-profit and for-profit sectors, Casey leverages a unique blend of skills in Corporate Social Responsibility, Public Relations, and Event Management to elevate the impact of the organization’s mission.  
  
In this leadership position, Casey oversees a dynamic team dedicated to planning and executing approximately 1,500 celebrity wishes each year, ensuring that each experience is not only memorable but also aligns with the wishes of children facing critical illnesses. With a caseload of over 400 celebrity wishes, Casey collaborates closely with celebrity managers, publicists, and influencers to identify and pursue wish-granting opportunities that resonate with the organization’s values. This involves meticulous talent management and strategic relationship-building, which are essential for creating authentic connections between celebrities and wish kids.  
  
Casey’s expertise in media relations and content strategy allows for the effective promotion of these heartwarming stories, amplifying the organization’s reach and fostering community engagement. By utilizing social media marketing and brand management techniques, Casey ensures that the wishes granted are not only celebrated but also inspire others to contribute to the cause. Through innovative storytelling and a commitment to excellence, Casey Thompson continues to make a significant impact at Make-A-Wish America, transforming the lives of children and their families while championing the power of hope and joy.

About FIAF - French Institute Alliance Francaise

French Institute Alliance Française (FIAF) is a 501(c)(3) not-for-profit organization incorporated in the State of New York. About Columbia | SIPA
---------------------

Since 1946, Columbia University’s School of International and Public Affairs has equipped emerging leaders with the skills, knowledge, and intellectual rigor to solve the world’s most critical public policy, geopolitical, social, and business challenges.  
  
SIPA is unique among public policy schools for its diverse, international student body, blend of expert scholars and practitioners who are passionately committed to driving progress in the global public interest, breadth of fields we engage in both traditional and emerging areas, independent research centers, and unparalleled access to global financial institutions, the United Nations, leading NGOs, and the cultural and commercial vibrancy of New York City.  
  
At a time of significant global complexity and change, a SIPA degree has never been more relevant. At SIPA, students undertake an inspiring curriculum that cuts across academic disciplines. They develop deep knowledge and practical problem-solving skills through capstone projects, fieldwork, and international internships. They learn from world-class faculty who contribute to Columbia SIPA through their scholarship, experience, mentorship, and broad networks. And they have a home in Columbia’s extraordinary university community.  
  
SIPA offers a variety of degree programs to meet the needs of both full-time students and working professionals, including the core two-year Master of International Affairs and Master of Public Administration degrees, the MPA in Development Practice, the MPA in Environmental Science and Policy, the Program in Economic Policy Management for mid-career professionals, the Executive MPA, and the PhD in Sustainable Development. SIPA also provides opportunities for students to earn a dual degree within Columbia or with six international partner institutions.

About Orchestra of St. Luke's (OSL)
-----------------------------------

Called “\[New York’s} hometown band” by The New York Times, OSL performs at venues throughout the city including Carnegie Hall, Lincoln Center, New York City Center, Merkin Hall, The Morgan Library and Museum, Brooklyn Museum, and many more. OSL is dedicated to cultivating a lifetime of engagement with classical music and offers free instrumental training and mentorship for students from elementary school through conservatory and beyond; produces guided community and educational performances for thousands of students and families; and owns and operates The DiMenna Center for Classical Music, New York City’s only rehearsal, recording, education, and performance facility expressly dedicated to classical music, serving more than 500 ensembles and more than 30,000 musicians each year. OSL has participated in 118 recordings, four of; which have won Grammy Awards; has commissioned more than 50 new works; and has given more than 179 world, US, and New York City premieres. Recent guests and collaborators include cellist Alisa Weilerstein, tenor Jonas Kauffman, composer Gabriela Lena-Frank, violinist Christian Tetzlaff, and pianist Jeremy Denk. As New York Magazine notes, the Orchestra has a “...reputation for being able to play virtually any score as if the musicians had all grown up with it under their pillows.”  \
  \
Learn more at OSLmusic.org or @OSLmusic on Instagram, Facebook, Spotify and more.  \

See behind the scenes of New York City's music-making community at The DiMenna Center for Classical Music @TheDiMennaCenter on Facebook and Instagram\

What types of services does TDIndustries offer?

TDIndustries provides a wide range of services including mechanical construction, facilities management, HVAC systems, plumbing, fire/life safety solutions, energy solutions, and automation and controls. Their comprehensive approach ensures that they can partner with clients throughout the entire life-cycle of a facility, from initial design and construction to ongoing operations and maintenance.

How does TDIndustries support energy efficiency in facilities?

TDIndustries emphasizes energy solutions that enhance the efficiency of facilities. They offer energy audits, retrofitting services, and the implementation of advanced HVAC systems designed to reduce energy consumption. Their team works closely with clients to identify opportunities for energy savings and to develop customized solutions that align with sustainability goals.

What is the Design-Build approach used by TDIndustries?

The Design-Build approach utilized by TDIndustries integrates the design and construction phases into a single contract. This method streamlines the project delivery process, enhances collaboration, reduces costs, and minimizes the timeline for project completion. By having a unified team responsible for both design and construction, TDIndustries can ensure that the project meets the client's vision and operational needs efficiently.

Can TDIndustries assist with indoor air quality issues?

Yes, TDIndustries specializes in improving indoor air quality (IAQ) through various services, including HVAC system upgrades, air filtration solutions, and regular maintenance checks. They assess the specific needs of a facility to implement strategies that enhance air quality, ensuring a healthier environment for occupants while also complying with industry standards.

What industries does TDIndustries serve?

TDIndustries serves a diverse range of industries, including commercial, industrial, healthcare, education, and government sectors. Their expertise allows them to tailor solutions to meet the unique requirements of each industry, ensuring that facilities operate efficiently and effectively while adhering to regulatory standards.

What career opportunities does TDIndustries offer for veterans?

TDIndustries is committed to supporting veterans by providing career opportunities that leverage their skills and experiences. The company offers various roles in mechanical construction, facilities management, and technical services, along with training programs to help veterans transition into civilian careers. TDIndustries values the discipline and work ethic that veterans bring to the workforce and actively seeks to recruit them.

About Amarillo Country Club
---------------------------

Amarillo Country Club was established in 1919 on the Ayers place west of the city. Its founding was led by banker and oil man, Charles A. Fisk and was the first of its kind in the Panhandle of Texas. With a population of nearly 16,000 and the oil and gas business beginning to boom, The Amarillo Country Club provided business men with a gathering place where they could exercise and relax in style. ACC has held several high profile exhibitions over the years, hosting greats such as Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Byron Nelson, Tom Lehman, Jeff Maggert and Ryan Palmer. In 2012, major renovations saw updates to the clubhouse, golf shop, cart barn, tennis courts and a major redesign of the golf course. We welcome you to explore the club and enjoy what we have to offer.

About BYJU'S
------------

BYJU’S is a global ed-tech company, providing highly adaptive, engaging and effective learning solutions to more than 150 million students around the world. Founded in India in 2011, BYJU’S mission is to make high-quality learning accessible to students everywhere.  
  
The BYJU’S family of brands includes Disney-BYJU’S Early Learn, BYJU’S Future School, Epic!, Osmo, Tynker, Toppr and WhiteHat Jr, along with our beloved flagship product BYJU’S – The Learning App. Together, BYJU’S solutions support Pre-K – 12 education and a wide range of competitive exams.  
  
BYJU’S delivers a world-class learning experience with tools that sit at the cross-section of mobile, interactive content and personalized learning methodologies. BYJU’S geography-agnostic solutions and 12,000+ teachers make learning engaging, with visual and contextual programs that adapt to the unique learning style, skill level and pace of each student. In addition, we have innovative partnerships with some of the world’s leading companies, including Disney and Google, to drive engagement and help even more students become active and lifelong learners.  
  
BYJU’S is backed by blue-chip investors including the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, Sequoia Capital, Bond Capital, Silver Lake, BlackRock, Sands Capital Management, Alkeon Capital Management, Sofina, Verlinvest, Tencent, Prosus (previously Naspers Ventures), CPPIB, General Atlantic, Tiger Global, Qatar Investment Authority, Owl Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Times Internet, Aarin Capital and IFC. Since 2017, we have completed more than 15 acquisitions, including companies in the U.S., UK, Austria, India and Singapore.  
  
A 2021 Time 100 Most Influential Company, BYJU’S is headquartered in India, with operations in more than 21 countries globally and learning programs in multiple languages. For additional information, please visit www.byjus.com.

About Day & Ross Supply Chain and Trade Networks
------------------------------------------------

We're here for the long haul. From a single truckload of potatoes in the 1950s to a fleet of thousands, Day & Ross has grown to become one of the largest transportation companies in Canada. With more than 7,500 employees, drivers, and owner operators, we’re a dominant player in cross-border and LTL/TL transportation, offering a diversified portfolio of transport and logistics solutions across North America. Our commitment to safety and sustainability is rooted in the family values we share with our parent company, McCain Foods Limited.We’ve been around for 70 years because we believe some principles just can’t be compromised. Call us traditional, but we treat your stuff like it’s our own.So whether we’re delivering precious cargo – like that sold-out shipment of holiday gifts — or a sense of stability for our own team and their families, we’re here for the long haul. It’s tradition. We've got you covered.We’ve built a reputation for on-time shipping service, total coverage, and customer satisfaction. We offer industry-leading Less-than-truckload (LTL), Truckload (TL), and temperature controlled services — including a high percentage of reefer units and ‘protect from freezing’ heater-equipped trailers. We also provide a full range of logistics solutions, dedicated fleets, and last mile and home delivery services. Whether you’re shipping a couch to an online customer or importing goods from across the world, we’ve got you covered.

About San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance
-------------------------------------

San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance is a nonprofit international conservation leader, committed to inspiring passion for nature and creating a world where all life thrives. The San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance (SDZWA) empowers people from around the globe to support their mission to conserve wildlife through innovation and partnerships. SDZWA supports cutting-edge conservation and brings the stories of their work back to two world-famous facilities, the San Diego Zoo and San Diego Zoo Safari Park—giving millions of guests, in person and virtually, the opportunity to experience conservation in action. The work of SDZWA extends from San Diego to strategic and regional conservation “hubs” across the globe, where their strengths—via their “Conservation Toolbox,” including the renowned Wildlife Biodiversity Bank—are able to effectively align with hundreds of regional partners to improve outcomes for wildlife in more coordinated efforts. By leveraging these tools in wildlife care and conservation science, and through collaboration with hundreds of partners, SDZWA has reintroduced more than 44 endangered species to native habitats. Each year, San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance's work reaches over 1 billion people in 150 countries via news media, social media, their websites, educational resources and the San Diego Zoo Kids channel, which is in children’s hospitals in 13 countries. Success is made possible by the support of members, donors and guests to the San Diego Zoo and San Diego Zoo Safari Park, who are Wildlife Allies committed to ensuring All Life Thrives.

We are dedicated to continually developing an inclusive and rewarding culture for the full range of talent that comprise our ecosystem - including hiring pledges with Military.com, AARP and a growing list of partners. About Japan Exchange and Teaching Program(me) (JET)
---------------------------------------------------

The Japan Exchange and Teaching (JET) Programme, founded in 1987, is aimed at promoting grass-roots international exchange between Japan and other nations. The number of countries sending participants has risen over the years, as has the number of participants. In 2022, the Programme welcomed 5,723 participants from 50 countries.  
The JET Programme enables local authorities (prefectures, designated cities and other municipalities) to employ foreign youth for the purpose of improving foreign language education as well as promoting international exchange at the local level. CLAIR administers the JET Programme in cooperation with the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA), and the Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT).  
Three types of jobs are offered on the Programme: Assistant Language Teacher (ALT) who are assigned to local boards of education or schools (elementary, junior and senior high) and carry out their duties under the guidance of Japanese Teachers of foreign language. Coordinator for International Relations (CIRs) are placed in the offices of local authorities or related organisations and engage in internationalisation activities under the guidance of a contracting organisations. Sports Exchange Advisors (SEAs) are placed in local authorities engage in sports-related activities and are involved in internationalisation activities through the instruction of specific sports.

About Quiet Events Inc.
-----------------------

Quiet Events is a worldwide company with offices across the US, Canada, Europe and Asia, the Silent Disco phenomenon has taken the world by storm. Hundreds of party-goers dancing, singing and never leaving the dance floor because they control the type of music they listen to! Unlike a regular party, at this one everyone receives a pair of unique headphones that tunes into three live DJs spinning anything from 80’s, Top 40, Hip Hop and everything in between.  
  
Quiet Events was founded in August 2012 after Founder, William Petz, discovered the “Silent Disco” concept, during a Caribbean Cruise. The experience was rebranded and reinvented to create Quiet Events, NYC’s first Quiet Clubbing Company.  
  
The special headphones are the cornerstone to delivering new and unique experiences to revelers, corporate and event planners – the options are endless. From what began as a unique ‘clubbing’ experience in clubs and bars, Quiet Events now hosts movie nights, quiet plays, city tours and outdoor dance parties.  
  
Quiet Events provides a party planning service, catering to both public and private needs. The company also rents out equipment so anyone can create their own quiet experience. Visit http://Rentals.QuietEvents.com

Welcome to L.A.’s hippest Boutique Real Estate Firm with some of L.A.’s most experienced real estate agents. Unlike most real estate offices, we only hire 10% of the agents that interview with us. The Collective is owned and managed by Anthony Vulin.  
  
Who is the Founder and Owner, Anthony Vulin:  
Anthony Vulin began his real estate career as a Broker, after graduating from UCLA in 2000. Three years later Anthony joined forces with Keller Williams Hollywood Hills and built the second most successful real estate team at that office. His team focused on the Hollywood Hills, West Hollywood, Beverly Hills and Bel Air. In 2006 Anthony was asked to manage and build kw Los Feliz. At this time he was the youngest kw manager in the Country. By the end of 2008, he took that office from # 5 in local market share to #1, and by the end of 2011, from #74 in closed units in all of LA to # 5. In 2011 he was able to open a business center for KW in Downtown LA. This was the first residential and commercial real estate office to open by a national company in DTLA.  
  
In 2012 Anthony moved to Keller Williams Studio City. He recruited nearly 100 agents in just over 15 months and doubled the offices profit.  
  
In August of 2013, Anthony resigned from Keller Williams. He then launched his very own boutique real estate company in West Hollywood…THE COLLECTIVE, with a second office set to open on the East Side of LA in 2015.  
  
He is always looking for talented agents who are looking to grow their business. Coaching and consulting agents is a true passion of Anthony’s. He believes that having knowledgeable agents that truly care about exceeding their clients’ expectations is what will make THE COLLECTIVE grow to be LA’s most desirable real estate company for agents, buyers and sellers.

About Gwinnett County Government
--------------------------------

Welcome to Gwinnett County — one of America's fastest-growing counties for the past 20 years. Our dynamic and exciting county combines the best of big-city living with the comforts of the suburbs.  
  
The county's population in 2000 was about 588,448 and we’ve only continued to grow since then, with our current population nearing one million residents.  
  
Gwinnett has many advantages, beginning with its location and road system. The county is just 45 minutes from Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport and 30 minutes from downtown Atlanta. Thanks to this location, 80 percent of the U.S. population is within a two-hour flight. Georgia Highway 316 has been extended to Athens, reducing travel time to the University of Georgia to 25 minutes. Gwinnett's infrastructure includes more than 2,750 miles of roadways to provide excellent mobility for our residents.  
  
The County Administrator and County Attorney are appointed by the Board of Commissioners and serve at its pleasure. To implement the Board's policy directives, the County Administrator uses a management team consisting of members of his immediate staff and 14 department directors. The 14 departments that make up the executive side are Police Services, Fire and Emergency Services, Corrections, Child Advocacy and Juvenile Services, Communications, Support Services, Financial Services, Community Services, Human Resources, Information Technology Services, Law, Planning and Development, Water Resources, and Transportation. Each department is run by a director who is charged with managing operations in a manner which stresses the County’s values.  
  
In addition to the executive side of County government, certain services are provided through Constitutional officers and independent elected officials. These external offices are created by the Georgia Constitution or through state law. In Gwinnett, they include the Sheriff, Tax Commissioner, District Attorney, Probate Court Judge, and Chief Magistrate.

About KPMG
----------

KPMG is a leading global organization of independent professional services firms, renowned for its comprehensive Audit, Tax, and Advisory services. Operating under the KPMG brand, member firms are strategically positioned across 143 countries and territories, employing over 265,000 professionals dedicated to delivering exceptional client service. Each KPMG firm functions as a distinct legal entity, ensuring accountability and tailored solutions to meet diverse client needs.  
  
In Sri Lanka, KPMG stands out as one of the largest and oldest Chartered Accountancy firms, with a rich heritage dating back to 1897. The firm boasts a robust resource base, comprising 18 partners and over 1,000 skilled professionals. KPMG Sri Lanka offers an extensive portfolio of services, including External Audit Services, Tax Services, Internal Audit and Risk Consultancy, Accounting Advisory, IT Advisory, Deal Advisory, Management Consultancy, and HR Advisory Services. This diverse range of offerings allows KPMG to cater to various industries, such as financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, and technology, among others.  
  
KPMG leverages advanced technologies and innovative methodologies to enhance its service delivery, ensuring clients benefit from data-driven insights and strategic guidance. By integrating cutting-edge tools and analytics into its operations, KPMG empowers organizations to navigate complex challenges and seize growth opportunities in an ever-evolving business landscape. With a commitment to excellence and a focus on building lasting relationships, KPMG continues to be a trusted advisor for businesses seeking to thrive in today's competitive environment.

About Trans World Entertainment
-------------------------------

Trans World Entertainment Corporation (TWEC) was established in 1972 by our Chairman Robert J. Higgins. The company is headquartered in Albany, NY. Trans World Entertainment went public in 1986 and is traded under the symbol TWMC on the NASDAQ stock exchange.  
  
Trans World is the largest specialty entertainment retailer in the United States of music, DVDs, Blu-Ray, video game products, electronics and accessories. TWEC owns and operates over 300 mall and freestanding retail stores across the United States and Puerto Rico, including: f.y.e. (For Your Entertainment), Suncoast and Second Spin.  
  
The company enjoys a competitive and entrepreneurial culture that promotes innovation, excellence and ownership. TWEC is a fast-moving and nimble environment that requires a strong sense of urgency, accountability and responsiveness. The leadership is collaborative and passionate and rewards a high energy, high drive, and high integrity style.  
  
Trans World employs approximately 4,000 associates nationwide, with its corporate headquarters and distribution center in Albany, NY. As the capitol of New York, Albany boasts an outstanding quality of life that is rich in culture, educational institutions and medical facilities. It is a short distance from Saratoga Springs, Lake George, Lake Champlain and several popular ski resorts. New York City, Boston, Montreal and Lake Placid are all within a 3 hour drive from Albany.

About The City College Of New York
----------------------------------

Since 1847, The City College of New York has provided a high quality and affordable education to generations of New Yorkers in a wide variety of disciplines. CCNY embraces its role at the forefront of social change. It is ranked #1 by The Chronicle of Higher Education out of 369 selective public colleges in the United States on the overall mobility index. This measure reflects both access and outcomes, representing the likelihood that a student at CCNY can move up two or more income quintiles. In addition, the Center for world University Rankings places CCNY in the top 1.2% of universities worldwide in terms of academic excellence. More than 16,000 students pursue undergraduate and graduate degrees in eight professional schools and divisions, driven by significant funded research, creativity and scholarship. CCNY is as diverse, dynamic and visionary as New York City itself.  
  
Outstanding programs in architecture, engineering, education and the liberal arts and sciences prepare our students for the future, and produce outstanding leaders in every field. Whether they are drawn to the traditional, like philosophy or sociology, or emerging fields like sonic arts or biomedical engineering, our baccalaureate graduates go on to graduate programs at Stanford, Columbia or MIT – or they stay right here in one of our 50 master's programs or our doctoral programs in engineering, the laboratory sciences, and psychology.  
  
Nowhere else in the city do undergraduates have so many opportunities to conduct research with professors and publish and present their findings. In our science, engineering and social science programs, more than 300 undergrads work alongside senior researchers in funded projects.  
  
Leading CUNY in funded research, we house a number of research centers.

Ben Cotton is a distinguished global marketing and enablement leader, currently leveraging his expertise at Ben-Cotton.com, where he curates a wealth of insights on sales enablement, SaaS, and growth strategies. At Ben-Cotton.com, Ben delves into the intricacies of digital strategy and online reputation management, offering actionable advice on influencer identification and outreach. His content development expertise shines through as he crafts engaging articles that resonate with marketers and business leaders alike. Whether discussing the latest trends in email marketing or sharing case studies of award-winning campaigns, Ben’s insights are grounded in real-world experience and a deep understanding of the SaaS landscape.  
  
In addition to his writing, Ben is passionate about empowering others through knowledge sharing and collaboration. He believes that success in marketing is not just about what you say but what you do, echoing the wisdom of Carl Gustav Jung. About Southern Bank and Trust Company
-------------------------------------

OUR HISTORY  
  
Southern Bank and Trust Company was originally chartered as the Bank of Mount Olive on January 29, 1901. The bank was founded by a group of local businessmen who wanted a locally owned bank based in the community. The Bank officially began operations at 102 S. Center Street, Mount Olive with one employee and $10,000 in total assets.  
  
As it continued to slowly grow in the 50's and 60's, management within the bank realized that its name may not be well received in other communities. So in 1967, the name was changed to Southern Bank and Trust Company. Southern has continued to grow organically, as well as through the acquisitions of other financial institutions, through purchases of individual branches from other institutions, and through the establishment of de novo branches.  
  
The bank currently has over $2.5 billion in total assets and operates over 60 branches in North Carolina and Virginia.  
  
  
HOW WE DO BUSINESS  
  
• We put safety and stability first. We do this through long-term perspective, sound credit practices and prudent management of our assets. This is how we’ve earned our customers’ trust for more than a century.  
  
• We work with integrity, applying the highest professional ethics in all circumstances. We do the right thing.  
  
• We build full financial relationships with our customers by gaining an understanding of their needs and goals and applying our knowledge, expertise and resources to provide solutions now and in the long term.  
  
• We provide excellent service through accuracy, courtesy, responsiveness and partnership - we do it right.  
  
• We hire the best talent in our local markets and value the contributions of each of our employees.  
  
• We are good corporate citizens, helping to build the communities we share.  
  
  
  
WHY WE EXIST  
  
Our Vision: To be the bank of preference by delivering a distinctive banking experience and unsurpassed dedication to our customers and communities.

Whether kicking field goals or booming kickoffs, McManus takes control of each play, delivering the ball with unrivaled precision and power.  
  
McManus got his start in football at Temple University, where he showcased his exceptional kicking abilities. During his time at Temple, he set the school record for field goals made in a season, finishing his college career with an impressive 60 field goals. McManus kicked an astounding 10 field goals of 50 or more yards, further proving his ability to handle pressure situations and deliver in crucial moments.

He holds numerous franchise records for the Broncos, including the most field goals made in a season and the most consecutive field goals made. Moreover, in 2015, he set a record for the most touchbacks in a single season, highlighting his impressive leg strength and ability to consistently kick the ball deep into the end zone on kickoffs.  
  
Off the field, McManus is equally impressive. He is committed to giving back to the community and has established the McManus Foundation to support causes that are near and dear to his heart. Through his foundation, he has organized charity events and raised funds for various causes, including cancer research, child welfare organizations, and military support programs. McManus is a true role model both on and off the field, using his platform to make a positive impact on the lives of others.  
  
In conclusion, Brandon McManus is a standout placekicker in the NFL, known for his incredible accuracy, powerful leg, and ability to deliver in clutch moments. From his college days to his record-setting career with the Denver Broncos, McManus has proven time and again that he is a force to be reckoned with. Beyond his achievements on the field, he is a dedicated philanthropist, using his platform to make a difference in the lives of others. David Carr is a legendary figure in the world of football, renowned for his exceptional skills as a quarterback. Born on July 21, 1979, in Bakersfield, California, Carr made a name for himself in both college and professional football, earning him a place among the game's all-time greats.  
  
Carr's journey towards greatness began during his high school years at Stockdale High School. There, he established himself as an outstanding athlete, displaying a natural talent for football. His exceptional arm strength, accuracy, and ability to read defenses were qualities that set him apart from his peers. Carr's consistent performance on the field caught the attention of scouts from top-tier colleges across the country.  
  
Ultimately, Carr chose to attend Fresno State University, where he continued to impress. As a freshman, he earned a starting position and went on to set numerous school records. His strong arm, quick decision-making, and innate ability to anticipate plays made him a feared opponent for opposing defenses. Carr maintained his momentum throughout his college career, solidifying his reputation as one of the most promising quarterback prospects of his time.  
  
In 2002, Carr's exceptional college career culminated in him being selected as the number one overall pick in the NFL Draft by the Houston Texans. This marked a historic moment for both Carr and the franchise, as he became the first player in the history of the Texans to be the top pick. Carr's arrival brought a wave of excitement and anticipation to Houston, as fans and analysts eagerly awaited the impact he would have in the NFL.  
  
Carr wasted no time in making his presence felt. In his rookie season, he showcased his extraordinary skills, often making plays that left spectators in awe. Despite playing in an expansion team known for its offensive struggles, Carr's talent allowed him to shine through. He exhibited remarkable poise and resilience, enduring numerous sacks and hits while continuing to lead his team downfield. His rookie campaign saw him break multiple rookie records, including the most completions and passing yards by a rookie quarterback in NFL history.  
  
While Carr's early career showed immense promise, it was also marked by the challenges of playing behind a suspect offensive line. He faced constant pressure from opposing defenses, leading to significant sack totals and the occasional injury. As the years progressed, Carr transitioned from expansion team starter to a highly sought-after free agent, eventually finding himself as a valued backup and mentor to younger quarterbacks across different teams.  
  
Beyond his statistical accomplishments, Carr's impact extended far beyond the playing field. His work ethic, leadership, and dedication to the game became an inspiration for teammates and fans alike. Carr's unwavering commitment to his craft and his ability to persevere through adversity set an example for future generations of football players.  
  
While Carr's career may not have unfolded exactly as many predicted, his legacy as a quarterback and influential figure in the game remains intact. His impact on the sport reaches far beyond statistics, as he forever changed the perception of what it means to be a great quarterback. Today, David Carr's name stands as a testament to the enduring qualities of resilience, determination, and passion that define the greatest athletes in football history.

About Tommy Bahama
------------------

Nearly 25 years ago, our founders started a brand based on the refined, unhurried attitude of coastal life. To our guests, Tommy Bahama soon became synonymous with laid-back style and the concept of living the Island Life.  
  
What started as a causal, upscale menswear collection quickly evolved into a unique luxury lifestyle brand. The Tommy Bahama offering has grown to include both men’s and women’s apparel, home and beach goods, and a thriving restaurant and bar business. Everything that bears the Tommy Bahama name is created with an unwavering eye towards quality.  
  
More than ever, our focus is on taking our guests someplace great — through exceptional service, upscale products, and delicious food and drinks. Maintaining our unique point of view requires a diverse team that includes apparel designers, e-commerce and technology experts, manufacturing and operations, and, of course, retail and hospitality professionals. We would love to have you share your talents with us!  
  
Tommy Bahama is part of Tommy Bahama Group, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Oxford Industries, Inc. (NYSE:OXM). Established in August 1992, with corporate headquarters in Seattle, Tommy Bahama is an island-inspired lifestyle brand that defines relaxed, sophisticated style in men’s and women’s sportswear, swimwear, accessories, footwear and a complete home furnishings collection. The company owns and operates over 160 Tommy Bahama stores worldwide, with 16 of those locations offering a Tommy Bahama restaurant & bar.  
  
Tommy Bahama products are also available at the country’s finest retailers, including Nordstrom and other specialty retailers and TommyBahama.com ships to over 100 countries. Additional stores will be opening this year. More information, please visit www.tommybahama.com.

About Sean Payton

Sean Payton is a dynamic and innovative football coach who has left an indelible mark on the game. Known for his offensive prowess and ability to adapt to ever-changing strategies, Payton has firmly established himself as one of the brightest minds in the sport. With a distinguished coaching career spanning over two decades, Payton has guided the New Orleans Saints to unprecedented success, including a Super Bowl victory in 2010.  
  
Born on December 29, 1963, in San Mateo, California, Payton has had an undeniable passion for football from an early age. As a standout quarterback at Naperville Central High School in Illinois, he possessed the leadership and mental acuity that would later define his coaching career. Payton continued his football journey at Eastern Illinois University, where he played quarterback and earned a degree in communications.  
  
Following his playing career, Payton ventured into coaching, serving as an assistant at San Diego State University and Indiana State before getting his big break in the NFL. In 1997, he joined the Philadelphia Eagles as their quarterbacks coach under head coach Ray Rhodes. Payton's ability to develop young talent quickly became evident, and he garnered attention from across the league.  
  
In 2000, Payton was hired by the New York Giants as their offensive coordinator. He revitalized a stagnant offense, helping the Giants reach the Super Bowl in 2001. His innovative play calling and ability to maximize the strengths of his players caught the eye of NFL teams searching for a head coach.  
  
In 2006, Payton was named the head coach of the New Orleans Saints, a franchise still reeling from the devastation of Hurricane Katrina. Payton's arrival injected new life into the organization, bringing hope to a city desperately in need of a lift. His offensive genius transformed the Saints into a perennial contender, and he quickly built a winning culture that had been absent for decades.  
  
Under Payton's guidance, the Saints' offense became a force to be reckoned with. He implemented an aggressive and high-scoring passing attack, led by future Hall of Famer Drew Brees at quarterback. Payton's ability to exploit matchups and create mismatches on the field allowed the Saints to consistently put up impressive numbers.  
  
The pinnacle of Payton's coaching career came in 2010 when the Saints captured their first-ever Super Bowl victory. With Payton's brilliant offensive mind and the leadership of Brees, the Saints exhibited an unstoppable offense, culminating in an exhilarating 31-17 triumph over the favored Indianapolis Colts in Super Bowl XLIV. The win solidified Payton's status as one of the premier coaches in the league.  
  
However, Payton's coaching journey hasn't been without its challenges. In 2012, he was suspended for the entire season by the NFL due to his involvement in the infamous "Bountygate" scandal, where players were rewarded for injuring opponents. Despite the setback, Payton's leadership and resilience were evident as he returned with a vengeance in 2013, leading the Saints to yet another playoff appearance.  
  
Off the field, Payton has proven himself to be a philanthropic force. Through his foundation, "Payton's Play it Forward," he has provided support and resources to individuals and communities affected by natural disasters. Payton's commitment to giving back mirrors his on-field ethos of leadership and teamwork, solidifying his status as a well-rounded and respected figure in the football community.  
  
With his offensive genius and unwavering determination, Sean Payton has left an indelible mark on the NFL. His ability to adapt to the ever-changing landscape of the game, combined with his astute play calling, has made him one of the most successful and respected coaches in the league. As he continues to lead the New Orleans Saints with his trademark passion and innovation, Payton's impact on the game and the lives he touches off the field will be remembered for years to come.

About Maria Schneider

Maria Schneider is a visionary leader and the driving force behind Dynofit, Inc., a pioneering biotech startup dedicated to revolutionizing health technology. As CEO and co-founder, Maria leverages her extensive expertise in product development and project management to spearhead innovative solutions that bridge the gap between consumer electronics and medical devices. Under her leadership, Dynofit has developed the groundbreaking Flexdot system, the first electromyography (EMG) wearable designed for remote patient monitoring in physical therapy. This cutting-edge device empowers individuals recovering from strokes, traumatic brain injuries, and cerebral palsy to regain muscle control and enhance their rehabilitation experience.  
  
Maria's personal connection to the mission of Dynofit is profound; as a mother of a child with cerebral palsy, she is deeply committed to improving the lives of those affected by similar conditions. Her passion fuels the company's vision to create accessible, user-friendly health technology that prioritizes both efficacy and affordability. With a strong foundation in entrepreneurship and executive management, Maria has successfully navigated the complexities of the startup landscape, driving Dynofit towards strategic growth and impactful partnerships.  
  
In addition to her leadership role, Maria is an advocate for innovation in the health tech sector, frequently engaging in public speaking and sharing insights on the importance of integrating advanced technology into patient care. Her ability to blend technical sophistication with practical application positions Dynofit as a leader in the industry, making significant strides in the realm of remote patient monitoring and rehabilitation. As she continues to push the boundaries of what is possible in health technology, Maria Schneider remains a beacon of hope for countless individuals seeking to reclaim their independence and improve their quality of life.

Viad is an S&P SmallCap 600 company.  
  
Pursuit is a collection of inspiring and unforgettable travel experiences in Alaska, Montana, the Canadian Rockies, Vancouver, Reykjavik, and Las Vegas, as well as new experiences planned in Chicago and Toronto. GES is a global, full-service live events company offering a comprehensive range of services to the world's leading brands and event organizers through two reportable segments, Spiro and GES Exhibitions. Spiro is an experiential marketing agency that partners with leading brands around the world to manage and elevate their global experiential marketing activities. GES Exhibitions is a global exhibition services company that partners with leading exhibition and conference organizers as a full-service provider of strategic and logistics solutions to manage the complexity of their shows with teams throughout North America, Europe, and the Middle East.

About Georgia Society Sons of the American Revolution
-----------------------------------------------------

The outstanding participation of our 29 chapters and nearly 1,400 members consistently brings national recognition to our Society as we work to perpetuate the people and events of the American Revolution, promote patriotism, and preserve the ideals of freedom.  
  
We conduct scholarship and recognition programs for high school and elementary school students, for ROTC and JROTC cadets, and for Eagle Scouts. Many of our members go into school classrooms, often in Revolutionary War uniforms or other period dress, and make presentations on the people and events of the Revolution, the Declaration of Independence, the United States Constitution, and other patriotic themes. We present medals of recognition to our public safety officials, perform volunteer work with Veterans, and conduct Revolutionary War grave dedications. Our Chapters proudly recognize deserving schools, businesses, and organizations with Flag Certificates for their proper and prominent display of the American Flag. Our Society is an active participant in historic battle site observances and other patriotic programs. The award-winning Georgia Society Color Guard participates in parades and posts the Colors at civic and historic events. We also support and work closely with the Children of the American Revolution and the Daughters of the American Revolution.
