About Marvin Zindler

Marvin Zindler was a legendary reporter known for his tenacious investigative reporting and flamboyant personality. Born in 1921 in Houston, Texas, Zindler began his career in journalism at the age of 17, working as a journalist for the Houston Post while attending the University of Houston. After serving in World War II, Zindler returned to Houston and eventually made a name for himself as a reporter and television personality.  
  
Zindler gained national attention for his investigative reporting, particularly his work exposing the illegal activities of the Chicken Ranch, a notorious brothel in La Grange, Texas. Zindler's relentless pursuit of truth and justice resulted in the closure of the establishment and inspired the Broadway musical and film, "The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas," which was based on his reporting.  
  
Beyond his work with the Chicken Ranch, Zindler was also known for his consumer advocacy reporting, often taking on powerful corporations and government agencies on behalf of the citizens of Houston. His "Marvin Zindler's Eyewitness News" segment on KTRK-TV became a platform for him to champion the rights of consumers and expose corruption and wrongdoing.  
  
While Zindler was respected for his hard-hitting reporting, he was also known for his larger-than-life personality and memorable catchphrases, such as "Slime in the ice machine!" and "Good evening, Mr. and Mrs. America, and all the ships at sea!" His distinctive voice and flamboyant style made him a beloved figure in Houston and beyond.  
  
In addition to his work as a reporter, Zindler was involved in various philanthropic endeavors, including the establishment of the Marvin Zindler Endowment for Leukemia Research at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center. Zindler's impact on the community was far-reaching, and his legacy lives on through the many lives he touched and the changes he brought about through his reporting and advocacy.  
  
Marvin Zindler's career as a reporter spanned over five decades, and his impact on the field of journalism and the community of Houston was immeasurable. He was a pioneer in investigative reporting and a fearless advocate for the rights of consumers and citizens. Zindler's legacy continues to inspire journalists and activists to pursue truth and justice, and his larger-than-life personality has left an indelible mark on the world of television journalism. He is remembered as a true hero of the people, and his contributions to the field of journalism will not be forgotten.

About Hayying Danışmanlık ve Sağlık Hizmetleri A.Ş.
---------------------------------------------------

Hayying Danışmanlık ve Sağlık Hizmetleri A.Ş., İstanbul'un Kadıköy ilçesinde bulunan, psikolojik danışmanlık ve sağlık hizmetleri sunan bir lider kuruluştur. Caddebostan Mahallesi'nde yer alan merkezimiz, güçlü bir psikolog ekibi ile yetişkin, aile, çift, çocuk ve ergen psikolojisi alanlarında kapsamlı hizmetler sunmaktadır. Ayrıca, endüstri ve örgüt psikolojisi alanında da uzmanlaşarak, bireylerin ve organizasyonların psikolojik ihtiyaçlarını karşılamayı hedefliyoruz.  
  
Hayying, bireylerin ruh sağlığını desteklemek amacıyla, psikologlarımızın rehberliğinde diyetisyen ve doğum koçu hizmetleri de sunmaktadır. Bu çok yönlü yaklaşım, danışanlarımızın fiziksel ve zihinsel sağlıklarını bütünsel bir şekilde ele alarak, yaşam kalitelerini artırmayı amaçlamaktadır. Hayying Danışmanlık ve Sağlık Hizmetleri A.Ş., ruh sağlığı alanında sunduğu profesyonel hizmetlerle, bireylerin ve ailelerin yaşamlarını olumlu yönde etkilemeyi hedeflemektedir. The Hattiesburg Convention Commission was created as an economic development agency in 1991 to construct and operate a convention center and other tourism-related facilities for the purpose of growing the value of tourism to Hattiesburg’s economy. Since that time, the Commission has been a powerful contributor to this effort by developing, marketing and operating numerous tourist facilities, including the Lake Terrace Convention Center, the historic Saenger Theater in Downtown Hattiesburg, the African American Military History Museum at the historic USO Club, the historic Eureka School Museum, and the Hattiesburg Zoo. About BB&T  
  
BB&T is one of the largest financial services holding companies in the U.S. with $220.5 billion in assets and market capitalization of $36.3 billion as of March 31, 2017. About Space Systems Loral
-------------------------

SSL, based in Palo Alto, California, is a leading provider of advanced spacecraft systems, with broad expertise to support commercial and government satellite operators and innovative space missions. The company designs and manufactures spacecraft for services such as direct-to-home television, video content distribution, broadband internet, mobile communications, in-orbit servicing, space exploration, and Earth observation. As a Silicon Valley innovator for 60 years, SSL’s advanced product line includes state-of-the-art small satellites, and sophisticated robotics and autonomous solutions for remote operations.  
  
The company’s reputation as a world leader is the result of its unparalleled commitment to performance and reliability, combining today’s advanced technologies with space-proven heritage designs. Billions of people depend on SSL-built satellites every day. A career with SSL could shape your future in ways that you've never imagined.  
  
SSL has export control and security issues that require attention to the citizenship status of every individual who performs work on its behalf. All jobs at SSL require that the employee either be a United States Citizen, Permanent Resident of the United States, an Asylee, or a Refugee. SSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  
  
SSL is a business unit of Maxar Technologies, a U.S. operating company (NYSE: MAXR; TSX: MAXR).

The Tennessee Titans are a prominent professional football team competing in the National Football League (NFL), headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee. The team made a significant move in 1997, relocating to Tennessee and subsequently opening their home stadium, Nissan Stadium, in downtown Nashville in 1999.  
  
The Titans are deeply rooted in the sports and entertainment industry, providing thrilling live football experiences and engaging fan interactions. They serve a diverse audience, from passionate local supporters to national fans, offering a range of services including game-day experiences, merchandise sales, and community outreach programs. The organization is committed to leveraging technology to enhance fan engagement, utilizing advanced analytics for player performance, and implementing cutting-edge stadium technologies to improve the overall spectator experience.  
  
As a key player in the NFL, the Titans are dedicated to excellence both on and off the field, striving for success in every season while fostering a strong sense of community. Their commitment to innovation and fan engagement positions them as a leading franchise in professional sports, making them a vital part of Nashville's cultural landscape. With a rich history and a bright future, the Tennessee Titans continue to inspire and entertain football fans across the nation.

About Pilgrim Place
-------------------

Pilgrim Place, located at 625 Mayflower Road in Claremont, California, is a vibrant senior community dedicated to individuals who have devoted their lives to careers in Christian services. This unique retirement community offers a supportive and enriching environment for retired clergy, missionaries, and other professionals who have served in various capacities within the church and broader Christian mission fields. Pilgrim Place fosters a sense of belonging and purpose, allowing residents to continue their journey of faith and service in their golden years.  
  
The community provides a range of services tailored to the needs of its residents, including independent living, assisted living, and skilled nursing care. Residents enjoy access to beautifully landscaped grounds, communal spaces for fellowship, and a variety of activities designed to promote physical, emotional, and spiritual well-being. Pilgrim Place also emphasizes lifelong learning, offering programs and workshops that encourage personal growth and engagement with contemporary issues facing the church and society.  
  
In addition to its residential offerings, Pilgrim Place serves as a hub for intergenerational connections and community outreach, often hosting events that invite local residents and organizations to participate in its mission-driven initiatives. The use of modern technologies enhances communication and community engagement, ensuring that residents stay connected with family and friends, as well as with the broader community. With a commitment to nurturing the spirit and honoring the legacy of its residents, Pilgrim Place stands as a testament to a life of service and faith, making it a cherished home for those who have dedicated their lives to the Christian mission.

About Pride London
------------------

This webpage is for the former Pride London organisation.  
For 2012 and beyond, please visit us at: https://prideinlondon.org.  
https://www.linkedin.com/company/prideinlondon/mycompany/  
  
Pride London aims to promote equality and diversity through all of its campaigns. The two week Pride festival uses theatre, music, debate, art and entertainment to raise awareness of discrimination and the issues and difficulties affecting the lives of LGBT people around the world. Our Parade is an explosion of Pride in the heart of the capital, attracting over 500,000 people in a celebration of diversity. Through this we aim to promote a sentiment in favour of equality, uniting people in a celebrative atmosphere where all are welcome, and fostering a sense of community within the LGBT population. Overall, Pride London hopes to promote understanding and cooperation, as well as education in diversity, in order to get rid of the discrimination faced by LGBT people.  
  
By associating LGBT voluntary organizations with one another, Pride London manages to maximize their effectiveness and their outreach to the LGBT community. By allowing these charities to promote their services to a wider audience, we give them the opportunity to share information and work together. This creates a platform at Pride London where people can come and learn about LGBT charities, and find support or get involved.  
  
Pride London is responsible for promoting, managing, arranging, supporting and conducting all the events of the festival, including the Parade, parties, exhibitions and entertainment. We recruit the best artists and entertainers, the top health advisors and high profile journalists to ensure that the events we put out are at the top of their game and that everyone who participates in Pride has a fantastic time. The website for PrideLondon (the former organisation) is no longer in use but can be viewed via a WebArchive search. The current website of the new organisation is below.

About myAgro
------------

myAgro is an award-winning social enterprise committed to empowering small-scale farmers on every level, from self-financing to agricultural training. We are working with 115,000 farmers and counting in Mali & Senegal. myAgro pioneered the use of mobile layaway as a model for savings layaway that can be adopted by other organizations to serve farmers throughout the world.  
  
Smallholder farmers across the globe make up 70% of the world’s poor. Our model has been shown to double farm income and helps farmers move out of poverty. We’ve grown from 240 farmers in 2011 to 115,000+ in 2021 and will continue to scale over the next five years while aiming for our North Star of reaching 1 million smallholder farmers by 2026.  
  
We’ve received early recognition for our work by Skoll Foundation, One Acre Fund and Mulago Foundation and received prestigious awards from: Echoing Green Fellowship, Rainer Arnhold Fellows, Draper Richards Kaplan Social Entrepreneurship. Learn more at www.myagro.org

Mike Slott currently serves as the Senior Manager of Global Support Operations at DoorDash, where he leads the Teammate Success team within the Customer Experience (CX) division. In this pivotal role, Mike is responsible for overseeing the Training, Quality Assurance, and Learning & Development functions that empower a global network of customer support teammates. His mission is clear: to ensure that every teammate is equipped with the necessary resources and training to provide exceptional and empathetic support to DoorDash's diverse customer base. Under his leadership, the Teammate Success team has implemented innovative training programs and quality assurance measures that have significantly enhanced service delivery and customer satisfaction.  
  
With a robust background in operations management honed through previous roles at Uber and Amazon, Mike brings a wealth of experience in optimizing support processes and driving team performance. His academic foundation from the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University, where he majored in Business Economics & Public Policy, complements his practical expertise, allowing him to approach challenges with a strategic mindset. Mike's proficiency in tools like Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, combined with his leadership skills, enables him to analyze data effectively and present actionable insights to stakeholders.  
  
As he continues to identify opportunities for improvement within the customer support landscape, Mike is committed to fostering a culture of continuous learning and development. His dedication to teammate success not only enhances operational efficiency but also contributes to DoorDash's overarching goal of delivering a seamless and satisfying customer experience.

About S&L Hospitality
---------------------

S&L Hospitality has established itself as a highly successful and respected hospitality development and management company. Long before the company was founded in 2005, the founders had a very long and prosperous partnership that included diversified real estate development and management, and a rock solid reputation for developing and operating first-rate hotels, resorts and spas.  
  
Before S&L Hospitality, the founders helped build one of the strongest development and management companies in the industry, The Great Lakes Companies, Inc (GLC). GLC built 18 hotels and resorts, as well as 40 assisted  
living and Section 42 developments between 1996 - 2004. In 1999, GLC acquired Great Wolf Lodge® in Wisconsin Dells, WI and helped build the company into what has become known as North America’s largest brand of indoor  
waterpark resorts. Renamed Great Wolf Resorts, the company went public in 2004. Shortly thereafter, a new venture began, called S&L Hospitality.  
  
Today, S&L Hospitality has hotels throughout the US ranging in size from limited-service properties to full-service hotels with restaurants, lounges, and meeting and banquet space. Their corporate team is comprised of hospitality  
industry experts in a range of specialty fields. With their office in Verona, WI, the S&L Hospitality team has prior experience developing and/or managing more than $800 million in hotels and resorts, indoor waterparks, high-end spas and a combined over 100,000 square-feet of conference and meeting space.

About BlockTower Capital
------------------------

BlockTower is an institutional investment firm, applying professional trading, venture investing, credit underwriting, and portfolio management to digital and traditional assets.  
  
Our strategies reflect how we want to invest ourselves:  
  
• BlockTower Flagship: Active trading directional exposure focused on liquid crypto assets via a multi-strategy approach analyzing both top-down market regimes and bottom-up asset selection (beta augmented with alpha), and incorporating market neutral strategies where appropriate to the opportunity set.  
  
• BlockTower Credit: Investing in real-world credit assets; traditional asset backed securities and structured lending solutions for fintech originators and non-bank lenders (eg, auto loans, trade finance, invoice factoring), and pursuing superior risk-adjusted returns using blockchain technology infrastructure.  
  
• BlockTower VC: Next-generation venture investing, applying the skills of both crypto-native and traditional VC to the growing web3 space; partnering with teams at the earliest stages as both investors and as users leveraging the BlockTower platform.  
  
We partner with the companies and projects building this paradigm-shifting technology, as investors and as users, from early stage to and through the liquid market journey. And we use and build blockchain infrastructure to create the future of financial services, including securitizing traditional assets on-chain, and working with real-world credit originators to provide capital and support as they move along their growth path.  
  
The firm was founded in 2017 by Goldman Sachs executive and engineer, Matthew Goetz, and University of Chicago Endowment portfolio and risk manager and Susquehanna International Group trader, Ari Paul.

We are a for-purpose community owned organisation and operate a variety of retirement living and aged care services in the Illawarra, Southern Highlands and Queanbeyan regions of NSW.  
  
We’ve been creating inspiring, supportive and connected communities for older people for over 50 years, and are proud to be innovative leaders of best practice.  
  
We believe that people matter most – our customers, our clients, our staff and volunteers. We understand that everyone is different and have unique experiences, needs and desires.  
  
We are only as good as our people. We are committed to attracting and retaining the best staff and finding innovative ways of improving their work experience. We offer a positive workplace culture, with a strong focus on customer service. Warrigal provide opportunities for learning and development, in a growth sector.

About The Trussell Trust
------------------------

Our aim is to create a hunger free future. We support a nationwide network of food banks and together we provide emergency food and support to people locked in poverty, and campaign for change to end the need for food banks in the UK.  
  
We support more than 1,200 food bank centres in the UK to provide a minimum of three days’ nutritionally-balanced emergency food to people in crisis who have been referred (for instance by advice agencies, GPs, social services and  
schools), as well as support to help people resolve the crises they face. Between April 2018 and March 2019, food banks in our network provided more than 1.6 million emergency food supplies to people in crisis, a 19% increase on the  
previous year.  
  
We know it takes more than food to end hunger. So we bring together the experiences of food banks in our network, and their communities, to challenge the structural economic issues that lock people in poverty, and campaign  
for change to end hunger and poverty in the UK.

What services does The Trussell Trust provide to combat food poverty?

The Trussell Trust operates a nationwide network of food banks that provide emergency food and support to individuals and families in crisis. Our services include food distribution, advice on accessing additional support, and referrals to other services that can help address the underlying issues of poverty. We work to ensure that no one has to face hunger alone.

How can I get help from a food bank supported by The Trussell Trust?

If you need help, you can find your nearest food bank by visiting our website and using the 'Find Your Local Food Bank' tool. You will typically need a referral from a professional such as a social worker, doctor, or charity worker, but some food banks may also accept self-referrals. Each food bank has its own process, so it's best to check their specific requirements.

How can I support The Trussell Trust and its mission?

There are several ways to support The Trussell Trust, including donating food, volunteering at a local food bank, or making a financial contribution. You can also help raise awareness about food poverty in your community and advocate for policies that address the root causes of hunger. Visit our website for more information on how to get involved.

What types of food donations does The Trussell Trust accept?

The Trussell Trust accepts a variety of non-perishable food items, including canned goods, pasta, rice, cereals, and toiletries. We encourage donors to check with their local food bank for specific needs, as these can vary based on the community's requirements. Please ensure that all donations are within their expiration dates and in good condition.

How does The Trussell Trust address the root causes of food poverty?

In addition to providing emergency food assistance, The Trussell Trust works to tackle the root causes of food poverty through advocacy, research, and partnerships with other organizations. We aim to influence policy changes and raise awareness about the systemic issues that lead to hunger, such as low wages, inadequate social security, and rising living costs.

Can businesses partner with The Trussell Trust to help fight hunger?

Yes, businesses can partner with The Trussell Trust in various ways, including corporate donations, sponsorship of food drives, and employee volunteering programs. We welcome partnerships that align with our mission to create a hunger-free future. For more information on how your business can get involved, please visit our website or contact our partnerships team.

About DRW
---------

At DRW, we identify and capture trading and investment opportunities globally. What sets us apart is our diversified approach—trading across many asset classes and instruments, in markets around the world, with horizons from seconds to years. We succeed by leveraging technology, research and risk management.  
  
We offer the best of both worlds: the opportunity and spirit of a startup and the benefits and stability of an established, experienced firm. Our employees work hard to solve interesting problems, and their results are rewarded. We value continuous learning—from our outcomes, from the environment and from each other. It’s a place of high expectations, deep curiosity, and constant collaboration, with some of the smartest, most passionate people you’ll meet.  
//  
Chez DRW, nous identifions et saisissons les opportunités de négociation et d'investissement au niveau mondial. Ce qui nous différencie, c'est notre approche diversifiée : nous négocions sur de nombreuses classes d'actifs et d'instruments, sur des marchés du monde entier, avec des horizons allant de quelques secondes à plusieurs années. Nous réussissons en nous appuyant sur la technologie, la recherche et la gestion des risques. About butter LONDON
-------------------

We are butter LONDON the bon vivants of beauty...cultured, confident, expertly curated, divinely distinctive, and authentically inclusive.  
  
butter LONDON boldly eschews conventional beauty... we believe playful is beautiful and we encourage you to live a little.  
  
Founded in 2005 by British entrepreneur, Sasha Muir with the help of Nonie Creme, London's premier fashion manicurist, butter LONDON quickly became the world-renowned 3-Free nail lacquer brand with a huge cult following. Today we continue to lead industry innovation with imaginative products, and good-for-you formulations in our expanded colour repertoire for eyes, lip & face using the same ingenious carcinogen-free Crafted with Care approach to formulations. We are high-impact captivating colour without compromise.  
  
Famous for unbridled creativity, self-expression, and unmistakable cheeky Brit wit... we're here to inspire. From our iconic ladylike botanical wallpaper emblazoned with faceted gems, bugs, and skulls to our distinctively charming shade names-think Disco Biscuit and Pink Knickers-if there's one thing you can expect it's the unexpected.  
  
Here's the clincher... butter LONDON is an American brand. Yep. Health Dialog complements these services by providing healthcare coaching and disease management through live online and phone consultations, empowering individuals to take charge of their health. Furthermore, Bartell Drugs, a regional chain with over 130 years of experience, continues to serve the health and wellness needs of the Seattle community.  
  
Rite Aid leverages cutting-edge technology to streamline operations and improve customer engagement, ensuring that patients receive personalized care tailored to their unique health needs. By focusing on customer-centric solutions and a commitment to wellness, Rite Aid stands at the forefront of the pharmacy industry, dedicated to improving the health and well-being of the communities it serves.

About B3Living
--------------

We're a local social business. We help people who are priced out of the market by renting and selling affordable homes.  
  
You'll find us working with our local community in Broxbourne and across southeast Hertfordshire, where we have just under 5,500 homes which support more than 12,000 people.  
  
A home is more than bricks and mortar and so are we. B3Living's services help our customers live comfortably in their homes: we look after our buildings and estates, and we support people when life changes - for example, when money gets tight or when they get older.  
  
Our values and social purpose matter to us; that's why we enjoy working here.  
  
Our mission is to create better futures. To make a sustainable, positive change to the housing crisis for our customers and communities - but none of that would be achievable without a team of great people.

B Corporate accredited agency

What we do  
  
The buzz of something new  
  
Milk & Honey PR is a small, energetic London, New York and Sydney based PR agency. Managing and nurturing reputations for ambitious growth companies.  
  
We work with senior decision makers to change the way businesses talk. We don’t start with numbers, we start with people. We specialise in enriching messaging. Making your story more beautiful, colourful, inspiring or simply less complicated.  
  
We weave these rich, emotive messages into intelligent campaigns that deliver business value.  
  
Who we are  
  
A hive of passionate storytellers and strategists  
  
We are intelligent, committed and passionate communicators and strategists. We are proud to be employee owned, which is key to our shared success.  
  
We obsess about getting the message right. Injecting warmth and passion into corporate storytelling. So, we work a little differently. We look at campaign outcomes not hours. Ensuring our creative ideas and strategic solutions deliver on the bottom line.  
  
Human relations  
  
We are an agency where people come first. Where passion and creativity are prized. Where clients are celebrated. One where there is time to think, to go the extra mile. A land of opportunity.  
  
What we stand for  
  
Beeline for growth  
  
Here at Milk & Honey PR we live and breathe our brand values. We are obsessed with delivering campaigns our clients will love. We will never compromise on our attention to detail, focused campaign design or our passion in delivery. We are focused on developing and investing in our talented team and infrastructure for growth.  
  
Purpose and profit  
  
At the core of our business are our values of energy, bravery, respect, passion, collaboration and loyalty. We work hard to make sure that what we do is right. Not just for us, but the people we work with and the communities around us.

What types of travel insurance does Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection offer?

Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection offers a variety of travel insurance plans designed to meet different needs. These include comprehensive travel insurance that covers trip cancellations, interruptions, and delays, as well as emergency medical coverage, baggage loss, and travel assistance services. Additionally, we provide specialized plans for adventure travelers and those seeking coverage for specific activities.

How does the travel assistance service work?

Our travel assistance service is designed to provide support to travelers in case of emergencies. This includes 24/7 access to a team of professionals who can help with medical emergencies, lost passports, and travel arrangements. Whether you need help finding a local hospital or rebooking a flight, our travel assistance team is just a phone call away, ensuring you receive the help you need while traveling.

What is Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance and why do travel agents need it?

Errors & Omissions (E&O) insurance is a type of professional liability insurance that protects travel agents from claims arising from mistakes or oversights in their professional services. This coverage is essential for travel agents as it safeguards against potential lawsuits from clients who may claim financial loss due to errors in bookings, miscommunication, or failure to deliver promised services.

Can I purchase travel insurance after I have already booked my trip?

Yes, you can purchase travel insurance after booking your trip, but it is recommended to do so as soon as possible. Many travel insurance plans have time-sensitive benefits, such as coverage for pre-existing medical conditions or the ability to cancel for any reason. The sooner you purchase your policy, the more comprehensive your coverage may be.

What industries does Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection serve?

Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection primarily serves the travel and hospitality industries. This includes travel agencies, tour operators, cruise lines, and other travel-related businesses. Our products are tailored to meet the unique needs of these industries, providing both travel insurance solutions for customers and E&O insurance for travel professionals.

How can I file a claim with Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection?

Filing a claim with Berkshire Hathaway Travel Protection is a straightforward process. You can initiate a claim online through our website or by contacting our customer service team. You will need to provide relevant documentation, such as your policy number, receipts, and any supporting evidence related to your claim. Our claims team will guide you through the process and keep you updated on the status of your claim.

About Michael Weamer

Michael Weamer serves as the President and CEO of The Marfan Foundation, where he leverages his extensive experience in the non-profit sector to drive impactful initiatives aimed at improving the lives of individuals affected by Marfan Syndrome, Vascular Ehlers-Danlos (vEDS), and related conditions. Under his leadership, the Foundation has made significant strides in research, advocacy, and education, ensuring that those living with these life-threatening genetic disorders can lead longer, healthier lives.  
  
Michael's expertise in governance and board development has been instrumental in fostering strategic partnerships and coalitions that enhance the Foundation's reach and effectiveness. His commitment to team building and leadership development has cultivated a dynamic organizational culture that prioritizes collaboration and innovation. Key projects during his tenure include the launch of comprehensive educational programs for patients and healthcare providers, aimed at raising awareness and improving diagnosis and treatment options for these complex conditions.  
  
Additionally, Michael has spearheaded fundraising initiatives that have successfully secured grants and philanthropic support, enabling the Foundation to expand its research efforts and advocacy campaigns. His adeptness in media relations has also amplified the Foundation's voice, ensuring that the critical issues surrounding Marfan Syndrome and related disorders are brought to the forefront of public consciousness. With a passion for making a difference in the healthcare landscape, Michael Weamer continues to champion the cause of those affected by these genetic conditions, driving forward the mission of The Marfan Foundation with unwavering dedication.

The Educational Theatre Association (EdTA) is a national nonprofit organization with approximately 135,000 student and professional members. About Sara's Market & Bakery
----------------------------

Sara's Market and Bakery has been a family owned and operated business since we first opened our doors in 1998. From the beginning, we have made it our top priority to provide top quality products, as well as put our customers first.  
  
Sara's Market and Bakery originally opened as a bakery producing fresh, oven-baked pita, and as the demand for our pita grew, so did requests to bring in additional, Mediterranean-influenced grocery items. The meats that we offer are certified Halal, and pass through the highest levels of inspection. Nothing we sell was ever treated with anti-biotics or given hormones, and all animals were raised and slaughtered humanely. We hold our produce to the same, high-standards. We purchase from local farms, and offer a large volume of natural, organic items. Our continued relationship with wholesome vendors allows us to provide for our customers a one-of-a-kind market experience.  
  
Past, present and future, Sara's will continue to provide to our customers a high-quality product at a reasonable, "petite" price. Additionally, we strive to offer honest, service, with a friendly face every time you, the customer, enters our store.  
  
At Sara's Market Bakery, we are not in business just to sell, but are in business to satisfy the needs of our customers and our surrounding community.  
  
At Sara's, we run our business with a conscience. What we serve, is what we eat.

About Carver County
-------------------

One of the fastest growing Counties in the state, it is no secret that Carver County is a great place to live, work, and play. Carver County offers the ideal combination of a picturesque natural setting and attractive professional opportunities.  
  
Carver County is a great place to live…Carver County communities have received a number of awards and accolades highlighting their first-class livability. About 100,000 people call Carver County home. The County offers a blend of fast pace suburban communities and pleasant rural towns. Our communities offer respected and growing schools and reputable medical facilities. Since 2013, the County has been ranked the healthiest in Minnesota.  
  
Carver County is a great place to work…Many employers both large and small call Carver County home. The County has a diverse industrial base with a strong concentration of advanced manufacturing. Highway 212 – a four-lane freeway – provides a critical transportation link between the metro area and points west.  
  
Carver County is a great place to play…Carver County is home to an array of outstanding recreational resources, including renowned golf courses, beautiful lakes, and many miles of hiking and biking trails through breathtaking parks. Bordered on the south by the wildlife-rich Minnesota River Valley, the County is home to the Minnesota Landscape Arboretum, Chanhassen Dinner Theaters, Lake Waconia -- the second largest lake in the Twin Cities. Hazeltine National Golf Course, site of the 2016 Ryder Cup, has hosted the 2009 PGA Championship and the 1991 US Open, among others.  
  
Carver County is enjoying a period of surging momentum and growth. Steeped in a rich history along the Minnesota River, our culture, community passion, and pride have made our county what it is today. Uniquely endowed by nature, and positioned just outside the urban center, Carver County truly does provide the best place in which to live, work, and play.

What services does Outcast offer?

Outcast provides a wide range of integrated marketing services, including communications strategy, digital marketing, creative services, brand development, content marketing, website development, media relations, and paid media. Our team of storytellers, strategists, and creatives work collaboratively to deliver tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client.

How does Outcast approach brand development?

At Outcast, brand development is a comprehensive process that involves understanding a client's vision, values, and target audience. We conduct in-depth research and analysis to create a unique brand identity and messaging strategy. Our team focuses on crafting compelling narratives and visual elements that resonate with consumers, ensuring that the brand stands out in a crowded marketplace.

What industries does Outcast serve?

Outcast works with a diverse range of industries, including technology, consumer goods, entertainment, lifestyle, and healthcare. Our expertise in integrated marketing allows us to adapt our strategies to the specific challenges and opportunities within each sector, ensuring that our clients achieve their marketing goals effectively.

Can Outcast help with social media strategy?

Yes, Outcast specializes in social business strategy, which includes developing and executing comprehensive social media plans. We help clients build their online presence, engage with their audience, and leverage social platforms to drive brand awareness and loyalty. Our team analyzes influencer insights and community management to create impactful social media campaigns.

What is the process for creating a content marketing strategy at Outcast?

Creating a content marketing strategy at Outcast involves several key steps. First, we conduct a thorough assessment of the brand's goals, target audience, and competitive landscape. Next, we develop a content calendar that outlines the types of content to be produced, distribution channels, and key performance indicators. Our team then creates high-quality, engaging content that aligns with the brand's messaging and resonates with its audience, ensuring a consistent and effective marketing approach.

How does Outcast measure the success of its marketing campaigns?

Outcast employs a data-driven approach to measure the success of our marketing campaigns. We establish clear objectives and key performance indicators (KPIs) at the outset of each project. Throughout the campaign, we utilize analytics tools to track performance metrics such as engagement rates, website traffic, conversion rates, and return on investment (ROI). This allows us to assess the effectiveness of our strategies and make data-informed adjustments to optimize results.

--------------

Headquartered in Los Angeles, SoCalGas® is the largest natural gas distribution utility in the United States. SoCalGas delivers affordable, reliable, clean and increasingly renewable natural gas service to 21.8 million customers across 24,000 square miles of Central and Southern California, where more than 90 percent of residents use natural gas for heating, hot water, cooking, drying clothes or other uses. Natural gas delivered through the company's pipelines also plays a key role in providing electricity to Californians— about 45 percent of electric power generated in the state comes from gas-fired power plants.  
  
SoCalGas' vision is to be the cleanest natural gas utility in North America, delivering affordable and increasingly renewable energy to its customers. In support of that vision, SoCalGas is committed to replacing 20 percent of its traditional natural gas supply with renewable natural gas (RNG) by 2030.

Dale Toney serves as the Chief Strategist for Corporate Benefits at Creekside Legacy Partners, where he leverages over two decades of expertise in wealth planning to empower executives, business owners, and high-net-worth investors. In his current role, Dale specializes in providing tailored, one-on-one guidance on the Smart Leverage Private Pension (SLPP) program, a cutting-edge strategy that utilizes bank financing to enhance retirement security. This innovative approach front-loads capital, enabling aggressive wealth accumulation while simultaneously creating a highly tax-advantaged retirement structure.  
  
Dale's proficiency in corporate finance, investments, and private equity allows him to navigate complex financial landscapes, ensuring that his clients can maximize their wealth potential. His deep understanding of annuities and insurance products further enriches his strategic offerings, allowing him to craft comprehensive plans that align with each client's unique financial goals. By focusing on fundraising and direct sales, Dale not only drives the growth of Creekside Legacy Partners but also cultivates lasting relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in their financial futures.  
  
Key projects under Dale's leadership include the development of customized financial frameworks that integrate the SLPP into broader wealth management strategies. His entrepreneurial spirit and management acumen have positioned him as a thought leader in the industry, enabling him to guide clients through the intricacies of wealth planning with clarity and precision. As a result, Dale Toney continues to be a vital asset to Creekside Legacy Partners, helping clients secure their legacies while navigating the evolving landscape of financial opportunities.

About OneLogin, Inc.
--------------------

OneLogin brings speed and integrity to the modern enterprise with an award-winning single sign-on (SSO) and cloud-based Identity and Access Management (IAM)/Identity-as-a-Service (IDaaS) solution. OneLogin has millions of users at more 2000 customers in over 44 countries, including AAA, Airbnb, Carlyle Group, Citizen, Condé Nast, Facebook, Fastenal, Gensler, GoPro, Herman Miller, Jabil, Netflix, News Corp, Pacific Life, Pandora, Riot Games, Steelcase, Tableau Software, Uber, WestJet, Yelp. OneLogin's cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM) solution allows enterprises of all sizes to secure their cloud and on-premise apps for all users and devices. Pre-integrated with thousands of applications, OneLogin enables IT to easily and securely tie their directory infrastructure to their business applications. IT then has centralized access control, can enforce rule-based security policies, enable multi-factor authentication and automate user provisioning and easily report on identity policy compliance. With OneLogin, enterprises strengthen security, eliminate directory integration costs and reduce password trouble ticket load. End users actively participate in enforcing the identity policy as they benefit from single sign-on access to the the thousands of pre-integrated apps for use on their laptops and mobile devices. Solution highlights: \* 100% on-demand \* Pre-integrated with 4,000+ apps \* Integrates with any web app \* Market leading directory integration with LDAP, Active Directory, Google Apps and Workday \* Single sign-on and self-service password administration \* Automated user on-boarding and instant off-boarding \* Role-based access control \* Strong authentication with a mobile one-time password app \* Two-factor authentication with RSA, VASCO, SafeNet, Symantec VIP Access and Yubico \* Identity compliance reporting \* SAML 1.1/2.0, WS-Federation and OpenID single sign-on \* Custom connectors for in-house apps \* Open-source SAML toolkits Recent OneLogin differentiating firsts demonstrating the company’s “bridge for authentication across cloud, on-premise and mobile” include: OneLogin Desktop for Mac: Featured as one of Network World’s “Hot Security Products at RSA 2016,” OneLogin Desktop for Mac is a cloud-based replacement for on-premise Active Directory and LDAP directories. OneLogin Real-Time Active Directory Sync: OneLogin has the industry’s fastest and most secure Active Directory connector. IT administrators can now automate the process of quickly granting and revoking cloud access to the right users at the right time. OneLogin Secure RADIUS for Meraki: OneLogin’s support for RADIUS-enabled appliances, such as Meraki wireless network devices, delivers safe, flexible and reliable authentication for Wireless and VPN with nothing to install on-premise — the area where other identity management solutions fall short. OneLogin Virtual LDAP: OneLogin ​is the only cloud identity management solution that ​supplies ​a virtual LDAP directory service. OneLogin’s Virtual LDAP (VLDAP) service enables organizations to unify multiple corporate directories and protect both on- and off-premise applications and devices. New Integration Platform: A new OneLogin integration platform built using real-time security event streaming, CASB and adaptive access policy technologies helps companies improve security automation and risk management. In June 2016 OneLogin acquired Portadi, a cloud-based password management tool. The acquisition enables OneLogin customers to increase employee productivity by automatically populating their OneLogin portal with apps as they manually sign into them. In December 2015 OneLogin acquired Cafésoft, a provider of on-premise Web Access Management (WAM) software, which allows OneLogin to provide a more comprehensive identity solution for hybrid environments. OneLogin is ranked a "Leader" in the 2015 Forrester Wave B2E Cloud IAM.

About Northern Plains Electric Cooperative
------------------------------------------

Northern Plains Electric Cooperative is a member-owned electric distribution cooperative serving 11,711 on 6,721 miles of line in North Central North Dakota. Specifically, a 50-70 mile wide area from south of Jamestown, ND to the Canadian border.  
  
Northern Plains is one of 16 distribution co-ops in the state; the largest geographically. Formed from the consolidation of Tri-County Electric Cooperative and Baker Electric Cooperative in 1997, Northern Plains is one of 640 electric cooperatives across the nation that are branding themselves as Touchstone Energy Partners. As a Touchstone Energy Partner, Northern Plains must undergo a compliance process every other year to document that it serves its customers with the highest levels of excellence. It must also provide evidence that it truly "has the power" of the Touchstone Energy brand: integrity, innovation, accountability and commitment to community.  
  
Northern Plains distributes electricity supplied by Basin Electric Power Cooperative and Western Area Power Administration. A member of the North Dakota Association of Rural Electric Cooperatives and the National Rural Electric Cooperative Association, Northern Plains is governed by a board of directors that are elected by members in district elections held each year.

About Third Way
---------------

Third Way is a national think tank that champions modern center-left ideas.  
  
Our work is grounded in the mainstream American values of opportunity, freedom, and security. But we identify as center-left, because we see that space in U.S. politics as offering the only real path for advancing those ideals in the century ahead.  
  
Our agenda is ambitious, aspirational, and actionable. It is built on the bedrock belief that for political movements to succeed in our political system, they must relentlessly re-imagine their policies, strategies, and coalitions.  
  
We are fighting for opportunity, so everyone has the chance to earn a good life; progress on social issues, so all have the freedom to live the lives they choose; and security, so we are protected from 21st century global threats.  
  
Our competitive advantage lies in our high-impact advocacy campaigns that combine rigorous policy research with a unique and incisive understanding of the vast American middle—the people who ultimately decide majorities and provide mandates for change. We design our work to persuade elected officials, intellectuals, advocates, the media, and others with political influence.  
  
Winner of the 2013 North American Think Tank of the Year by Prospect Magazine, Britain’s leading monthly current affairs magazine, for its ‘original, influential, and rigorous work on the most pressing challenges facing people, governments, and businesses.’ Third Way’s impact on the debate has prompted Reuters to opine: "Third Way is the future of think tanks" and The New York Times to note that the organization “has become a constant presence in Washington.” POLITICO’s Mike Allen wrote that Third Way is “the moderate voice of the progressive movement.” And Greg Easterbrook of The Atlantic observed that Third Way “is rapidly emerging as Washington’s most important beyond-ideology think tank.”

About The Funplex
-----------------

The Funplex Amusement Parks consists of two parks in East Hanover & Mount Laurel New Jersey. Each park shares similar experiences like the bowling alley, go-kart racing, waterparks and more.  
  
Check out The Funplex Mount Laurel for an Indoor and Outdoor Experience with more than 25 acres of indoor and outdoor fun, this award-winning family entertainment center has become the go-to venue for corporate events, parties or simply a day of family fun! The Indoor Boardwalk captures all of the fun of the shore closer to home! Boardwalk rides like the AirShot and Fun-A-Whirl are mixed with the Electric Go Karts, a 16-lane Bowling Alley, Laser Tag, Arcade, XD Dark Ride, Foam Frenzy, Bumper Cars & Jr. Bumper Cars.  
  
Take a trip outdoors in the Spring, Summer & Fall for thrill-a-minute rides like the all new High Velocity Drop Tower, FunCoaster, Fun Twister, Galleon of Fun Pirate Ship, Bumper Boats and More! Stay even longer to enjoy the hugely-popular Splashplex Waterpark, our massive outdoor Water Park features a 5 story slide tower, lazy river, activity pool and playground structure for the little ones.  
  
Established in 1997 The Funplex East Hanover offers more than 100,000 sq. ft. of fun! The Brand New Indoor Boardwalk is the your local place for weatherproof family fun. 20 lanes of bowling with 6 lanes in a private bowling suite, racing, and rides plus all your favorite boardwalk snacks. The Funplex state-of-the-art arcade, FunTron Laser Tag, XD Dark Ride, fast-paced Electric Go-Karts, Foam Frenzy and Bumper Cars come together to create the perfect trip to peak everyone's interest. Outside, guests enjoy the hugely-popular Splashplex Water Park, open from Memorial Day through Labor Day. The water park features an Interactive Pool, cascading Infinity Pool, Splash Pad, Lazy River, Body Slides, Coal Mine Railway, 5-story Prospector's Journey tube slide and 6-second plunging Gold Rush water slide.

About Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants
----------------------------------

At Kimpton, it’s always personal. We focus on what it means to be human and an individual. You’ll quickly learn Kimpton’s not just a hospitality job. Here, you’ll join a mission to make lives better. No biggie.  
  
The real you is a job requirement; your diverse background, talents, and quirks are what help our company connect meaningfully with our guests. You’ll lead your own personal career path while you help make each guest’s journey feel more personal. You won’t just punch a clock and count the hours; you’ll make it count.  
  
That’s why FORTUNE magazine has put Kimpton on its “Best Companies To Work For” list nine times. It’s why we score 100 on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s Corporate Equality Index every year. Our guests feel it too—it’s why we’re consistently ranked as a best-loved hospitality company.  
  
Our thriving company culture, numerous hospitality career tracks, and rich benefits and perks also make us one of the best places to work. We take care of all of our people with great benefits, like paid time off; medical, dental, and vision plans; life, short-term, and long-term disability insurance; 401(k) with employer matching; 6 weeks paid paternity/maternity leave; back-up child and elder care; robust professional and personal development through our own Kimpton University; and employee discounts at our 60+ hotels nationwide. Plus, we throw in some extra Kimpton-style perks, like wellness programs and, of course, pet insurance.  
  
We’re a best place to work because we’re driven by our passion for unscripted, heartfelt care. From the first whirl of a hula hoop at your employee orientation (yes, it happens) to every Kimpton Moment thereafter, you’re going to love it here as much as our guests do.

About Morgan Brice

Morgan Brice is a dedicated and versatile professional with over a decade of experience in the broadcast media industry, currently serving as an Evening News Anchor at KHQ-TV. In this role, Morgan not only delivers compelling news stories but also takes on the responsibilities of reporting and producing, ensuring that each segment resonates with viewers. Beyond the newsroom, Morgan's commitment to community welfare is exemplified through her role as a Board Member for Watson's Paws for the Cause, a non-profit organization based in Pasco, Washington.  
  
At Watson's Paws for the Cause, Morgan leverages her extensive skills in marketing and fundraising to support the organization's mission of preventing cruelty to animals. The organization, sponsored by the Pet Medical Center of Pasco, provides vital services such as temporary shelter, medical support, and behavioral assistance for stray, abandoned, and surrendered animals. Morgan actively participates in strategic planning and outreach initiatives, utilizing her expertise in social media marketing and networking to raise awareness and funds for the cause.  
  
Her background in broadcast journalism enhances her ability to craft engaging narratives that highlight the organization's impact, fostering a deeper connection with the community. By combining her passion for storytelling with her commitment to animal welfare, Morgan Brice is making a significant difference in the lives of countless animals while inspiring others to join in the fight against cruelty. Through her dual roles in media and non-profit work, she exemplifies the power of using one's platform for positive change.

Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham® - an award-winning chain of all newly constructed, interior-corridor economy hotels - is one of the industry’s fastest growing hotel brands and a leader in its class. We pride ourselves on being an economy brand that delivers a mid-scale experience.  
  
This is an exciting time for the Microtel brand. Our re-designed prototype launched in several markets across North America and is setting a new standard for economy travelers. All new hotels feature single, double and suite guestrooms with flat-panel televisions, desk units equipped with easily- accessible power and data ports. Other standard amenities include free Wi-Fi, free local and long distance phone calls and a complimentary continental breakfast. At most hotels, guests can enjoy Microtel’s fitness centers, business centers and swimming pools. Select hotels now feature a “Micro Mart” and meeting space.  
  
And don’t forget to ask about the Wyndham Rewards® Loyalty Program, featuring the go freeSM, go fastSM and go get 'emSM awards, which offers members a generous points-earning structure and a flat, free night redemption rate. If you are not already a member, you can learn more and enroll by visiting www.wyndhamrewards.com, or ask about Wyndham Rewards at the front desk upon check-in.  
  
Whether traveling for business or pleasure, you can also rely on www.wyndhamhotels.com/microtel to help simplify your planning with special offers, driving directions, points of interest, and real-time reservation services at our hotels.  
  
Our commitment is to deliver excellent customer service to all of our guests and provide consumers with an experience they may not expect in the economy segment. With over 325 hotels situated in the US, Canada, Latin America and Asia, Microtel is the right choice for today's travelers’ needs.  
  
We look forward to welcoming you soon!

About Community Coalition
-------------------------

Our Mission:  
To help transform the social and economic conditions in South LA that foster addiction, crime, violence and poverty by building a community institution that involves thousands in creating, influencing and changing public policy.  
  
Who We Are:  
Community leaders, including U.S. Congresswoman Karen Bass, founded Community Coalition as a non-profit organization in 1990 in response to the 1980's crack cocaine epidemic that devastated South LA. The goal was to provide preventative community-centered solutions to the drug problem.  
  
Community Coalition works with African American and Latino residents to build a prosperous and healthy South LA with safe neighborhoods, quality schools, a strong social safety net and positive economic development in order to reduce crime, poverty and substance abuse in our community.

About Atrium Health
-------------------

Atrium Health is a nationally recognized leader in shaping health outcomes through innovative research, education and compassionate patient care. Based in Charlotte, North Carolina, Atrium Health is proud to be a part of Advocate Health, the third-largest nonprofit health system, serving nearly 6 million patients across six states. It provides care under the Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist name in the Winston-Salem, North Carolina, region, as well as Atrium Health Navicent and Atrium Health Floyd in Georgia and Alabama. Atrium Health is renowned for its top-ranked pediatric, cancer and heart care, as well as organ transplants, burn treatments and specialized musculoskeletal programs. A recognized leader in experiential medical education and groundbreaking research, Wake Forest University School of Medicine is the academic core of the enterprise, including Wake Forest Innovations, which is advancing new medical technologies and biomedical discoveries. Atrium Health is also a leading-edge innovator in virtual care and mobile medicine, providing care close to home and in the home. Ranked nationally among U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals in eight pediatric specialties and for rehabilitation, Atrium Health has also received the American Hospital Association’s Quest for Quality Prize and its 2021 Carolyn Boone Lewis Equity of Care Award, as well as the 2020 Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services Health Equity Award for its efforts to reduce racial and ethnic disparities in care. With a commitment to every community it serves, Atrium Health seeks to improve health, elevate hope and advance healing – for all, providing $2.46 billion last year in free and uncompensated care and other community benefits.

Howard Goodall is currently on a career break, dedicating valuable time to his role as a stay-at-home parent while nurturing his son’s early development. With a robust background in haematology and pain management, Howard has successfully navigated complex clinical trials, contributing to Phase I/IIa and Phase III studies that have significantly advanced patient care.  
  
During his career, Howard has honed his expertise in pharmacokinetics and metabolism, ensuring that drug development processes adhere to Good Clinical Practice (GCP) standards. His strategic planning skills have been instrumental in managing early access programs and publication planning, aligning with the ABPI Code of Practice to ensure ethical compliance in all medical communications. As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), he has effectively bridged the gap between clinical research and healthcare professionals, fostering collaborations that enhance the understanding of innovative therapies.  
  
While on this career break, Howard remains engaged with industry developments, leveraging his knowledge to stay informed about emerging trends in oncology and clinical research. His commitment to professional growth continues as he explores opportunities to integrate his expertise into future roles, all while cherishing the irreplaceable moments spent with his son. About Shindigz
--------------

Shindigz is one of the world’s leading e commerce retailers of party supplies, decorations and personalized favors. We offer over 20,000 unique and customized solutions direct to customers around the world for celebrations from birthdays to weddings to company events to proms and graduations and all holidays. We are a 94 year old start up and we exist to change the way the world celebrates and to simplify the spectacular. We have a new HQ in DTFW and are excited to offer an unique, open and collaborative workspace and to be an active leader in the transformation of downtown. We are looking for talented team members to join us who want a flexible work environment, an open, transparent and collaborative experience, a culture built on fun, accountability and doing the right thing for our customers, our fellow team members, our partners and our community. We want positive, engaged and results oriented team members who want to make an impact and make a difference. (And who like puppies at work, free beer and wine, lots of celebrations and chocolate covered cashews.)  
We are a technology, design and creative company and we not only have our super awesome 110 year old HQ but we also operate our 125,000 square foot Operations Center with over 150 hands on team members bringing our party dreams to life each day with fulfillment and distribution, digital printing, and light manufacturing. We are a multi shift operation and are always looking for talented team members to join the team.  
Where Fun Comes to Party!

We are a not-for-profit professional membership association established by volunteer Sales Enablement practitioners. Our vision is simple: to elevate "Sales Enablement" as a recognized profession globally and define and share best practices and tools as well as connect and network with others in the Sales Enablement ecosystem. Please join our free and active member community at www.sesociety.org The Sales Enablement Society (SES) is a volunteer organization focused on elevating the role of Sales Enablement in organizations worldwide through engagement, communication, research, and development.Founded in 2016 with five founding members, the SES has grown to more than 5,500 members in 17 countries with 55 chapters across the globe. Members represent all areas of the sales enablement community – practitioners, suppliers, industry experts, and academics. SES Community WebsiteThe purpose of the SES Community website is to provide our members with a dedicated, online presence to share successes, challenges, constructive feedback, questions, and goals instead of products or services. Comcast Technology Solutions supports a diverse range of industries including media and entertainment, telecommunications, sports, and education. Our solutions are designed to meet the unique needs of each sector, providing tools for content delivery, live event streaming, and media management.

What services does Comcast Technology Solutions offer for live event streaming?

We offer comprehensive live event streaming services that include production support, content delivery, and real-time encoding. Our solutions ensure high-quality streaming experiences for audiences, with features like adaptive bitrate streaming and global content delivery networks to minimize latency and maximize reach.

How does Comcast Technology Solutions ensure content security?

Content security is a top priority for Comcast Technology Solutions. We utilize advanced conditional access systems, encryption technologies, and secure content delivery networks to protect your media assets. Our solutions also include server-side ad insertion and rights management to ensure that content is delivered securely and in compliance with licensing agreements.

Can Comcast Technology Solutions assist with ad delivery and management?

Comcast Technology Solutions offers a comprehensive media management platform that streamlines the process of storing, organizing, and distributing media assets. About Benevis
-------------

Benevis is an integrated Dental Services Organization (DSO), headquartered in Marietta, GA that operates and supports 160 dental offices throughout the country. In 2002, our founding dentists envisioned a company that could provide needed dental care to often under-served communities, while helping dentists manage the day-to-day administrative burdens of operating a dental office. In 2004, we created our award-winning DentaPro dental practice management system for large groups. In 2019, we acquired DPMS, Inc. further expending our non-clinical support abilities. In 2014, we officially changed our name to Benevis to better reflect the company’s mission to improve access to dentistry by providing the highest quality non-clinical practices services to some of the nation’s leading dental practices.Over the years, we have grown to over 2 million patient visits per year and expanded our service offerings to become an industry leader in providing non-clinical, business support services to dental practices in 17 states. Benevis now employs more than 3,500 employees and nearly 500 Dentists, working toward innovative advancements to deliver the very best patient care and experience with our doctor led, patient focused approach.We value teamwork, mutual respect and cooperation. We do not practice unlawful discrimination, including harassment or tolerate it in our workplace. What do we mean by discrimination? We mean that we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

### Frequently Asked Questions about VPC Development Management Group

What types of services does VPC Development Management Group offer?

VPC Development Management Group provides a wide range of advisory and management services tailored for the real estate development industry. Our specialties include strategic planning, asset management, consulting, engineering, sustainability, construction inspection, construction management, development management, government affairs, public-private partnerships, construction quality control, and facilities operations. We aim to support our clients at every stage of their development projects.

How does VPC ensure sustainability in its projects?

VPC Development Management Group prioritizes sustainability by integrating environmentally friendly practices into our project management processes. We focus on energy-efficient designs, sustainable materials, and compliance with local environmental regulations. Our team works closely with clients to develop strategies that minimize environmental impact while maximizing resource efficiency, ensuring that projects are not only successful but also sustainable for the long term.

What industries does VPC Development Management Group serve?

VPC Development Management Group serves a diverse range of industries within the real estate development sector. Our clients include residential, commercial, and industrial developers, as well as government entities and public-private partnerships. We tailor our services to meet the specific needs of each industry, ensuring that our clients receive expert guidance and support throughout their development projects.

Can VPC assist with government affairs and public-private partnerships?

Yes, VPC Development Management Group has extensive experience in navigating government affairs and facilitating public-private partnerships. Our team understands the complexities of regulatory frameworks and can assist clients in securing necessary permits, engaging with government agencies, and structuring partnerships that align public interests with private investment. We aim to foster collaboration that benefits both parties and enhances project outcomes.

What is the process for engaging VPC's consulting services?

Engaging VPC Development Management Group's consulting services typically begins with an initial consultation to understand your specific needs and project goals. Following this, we conduct a thorough assessment of your project, providing tailored recommendations and strategies. Our team works collaboratively with you throughout the implementation phase, ensuring that our insights translate into actionable plans that drive project success.

How does VPC ensure quality control during construction projects?

VPC Development Management Group employs a comprehensive quality control process during construction projects. Our team conducts regular inspections and assessments to ensure compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and safety regulations. We utilize a proactive approach to identify potential issues early, allowing for timely interventions that maintain project integrity and quality throughout the construction phase.

About Yorkshire County Cricket Club
-----------------------------------

The Yorkshire County Cricket Club is one of the world's most famous cricket clubs. Founded in 1863, Yorkshire is England's most successful club, winning a record 33 County Championships, joint Champions twice and five One-Day cricket crowns. Yorkshire can also lay to claim producing more England players in history than any other County, and no fewer than five players – Geoffrey Boycott, Len Hutton, Wilfred Rhodes, Fred Trueman and Herbert Sutcliffe – have been inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame. There is no other English county that can boast five members in the Hall of Fame.  
  
Away from the professional arena, Yorkshire is the hotbed of cricket in the country with in excess of 850 grassroots clubs and schools playing the game every week in the summer equating to over 125,000 recreational players.  
  
Its outstanding work in the local community, via the Yorkshire Cricket Foundation, is regarded as one of the region’s best organised sporting foundations with over 20,000 schoolchildren visiting the Club’s home Headingley Cricket Ground across the year.  
  
Headingley is also one of the world’s renowned international venues and is guaranteed the staging of international cricket every year until at least 2019. The ground opened in 1890 and will celebrate 125 years of sporting heritage in 2015.  
  
The Club play their matches at Headingley Cricket Ground in Leeds and also play home games at North Marine Road, Scarborough – the home of the world famous Scarborough Cricket Festival.

Thành lập từ năm 2006, Công ty cổ phần Chứng khoán VPS (VPS) - tiền thân là Công ty cổ phần Chứng khoán Ngân hàng TMCP Việt Nam Thịnh Vượng, đã trở thành một trong những công ty chứng khoán lớn nhất Việt Nam với vốn vốn điều lệ đạt 3.500 tỷ đồng và quy mô tổng tài sản 10.274 tỷ đồng tính đến thời điểm 30/06/2019.VPS cung cấp các sản phẩm đa dạng, chất lượng cao, tạo nên giá trị gia tăng cho doanh nghiệp và nhà đầu tư, bao gồm: Môi giới chứng khoán, Dịch vụ tài chính, Dịch vụ ngân hàng đầu tư, Tư vấn tài chính và phân tích. Là tổ chức trung gian tài chính, hoạt động ngân hàng đầu tư là trọng tâm xuyên suốt trong định hướng phát triển của chúng tôi. Cụ thể, VPS thực hiện các dịch vụ tài chính như thu xếp vốn, bảo lãnh phát hành chứng khoán, hoạt động mua bán và sáp nhập doanh nghiệp (M&A), tư vấn xác định giá trị doanh nghiệp, cơ cấu lại vốn, nợ trong từng giai đoạn, thời kỳ.Với mục tiêu cung cấp các sản phẩm và dịch vụ tài chính vượt trội mang đẳng cấp quốc tế, VPS đã quy tụ được đội ngũ chuyên gia trong và ngoài nước giàu kinh nghiệm trên thị trường tài chính, cùng với việc trang bị một hệ thống công nghệ thông tin hiện đại nhất. Những kết quả đạt được đã giúp VPS ngày càng khẳng định vị thế trên thị trường tài chính Việt Nam, trở thành một trong những định chế tài chính uy tín hàng đầu Việt Nam và khu vực.VPS luôn coi trọng chính sách phát triển nhân sự dài hạn, ưu tiên đãi ngộ những nhân sự giỏi được đào tạo trong nước và quốc tế. Ngoài các chế độ phúc lợi theo quy định, nhân sự đến với VPS còn được hưởng nhiều chế độ đãi ngộ hấp dẫn khác. They also analyze data on road safety trends and conduct surveys to gauge the impact of their educational initiatives on community awareness and driving habits.

Can I access online resources or training through DRIVE SMART Virginia?

Yes, DRIVE SMART Virginia provides online resources and training options for individuals looking to improve their driving skills or learn more about road safety. About Bentwater Yacht & Country Club - Lake Conroe, TX
------------------------------------------------------

Located just north of Houston, Texas, Bentwater is a 1,400-acre master-planned community nestled between two breathtaking, protected natural environments – the 22,000-acre Lake Conroe and the 160,000-acre Sam Houston National Forest. The setting is lush and beautiful, taking advantage of the Texas piney woods and boasting more than 12.5 miles of shoreline, two private islands and acres of gently rolling hills blanketed with pine and hardwood trees. Bentwater redefines the lake resort lifestyle and proudly takes its place as the only private, gated, waterfront community in Texas with 54-holes of championship golf, a Country Club, Yacht Club & Marina, a Racquet Club, Fitness Center, Day Spa, Pro Shops, and two private islands.  
  
Bentwater is the latest in a long line of successful master-planned communities pioneered by Belin & Associates of Houston. For over 50 years, the company has perfected the modern day "country club" community as we know it.  
  
Inspired by the features of the land, Bentwater is a private, gated community that carefully blends the natural beauty of the property with a resort-like array of amenities including a full-service country club with 54 holes of championship golf, a yacht club, a marina and a fitness club and day spa. Yet for all its attributes, Bentwater is just a few miles away from every luxury and every necessity, including shopping, dining, medical facilities, schools, major thoroughfares and more. Additionally, Bush Intercontinental (IAH), one of the country's largest airports, is within minutes from Bentwater, facilitating travel to points throughout the world.

Welcome to the BEST WESTERN Premier Denham Inn & Suites and the Best Western PLUS Edmonton Airport! We are two deluxe, full-service Edmonton area hotels with newly remodeled suites, free internet and free shuttle service to the Edmonton International Airport (YEG).  
  
We take great pride in offering attentive customer care to every guest traveling for business or leisure to Leduc, Alberta. Travelers will find a variety of attractions near the hotel including Castrol Raceway, West Edmonton Mall, Reynold's Alberta Museum and the Leduc Golf & Country Club, two of the region’s most popular golf courses. Business travelers will be near many corporate locations including Nisku Industrial Park, Ritchie Brothers Auctions, Weatherford, Baker Hughes, Halliburton, Precision Drilling, National Oilwell and Fiberex.  
  
Boasting newly renovated, stylishly designed & luxuriously appointed guest rooms, our accommodations showcase pillow top comfort, plush bedding & LCD Flat Screen Televisions. Standard amenities include complimentary Internet Access, mini-fridges, microwaves and charging stations.  
  
Additional hotel amenities at the Best Western Premier Denham Inn include an exercise facility, hot tub and two on-site outlets: O'Brian's, featuring superb regional cuisine and Jonathan's offering a fun environment and cocktails. A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily. Business, conference, banquet and ballroom facilities are also available.  
  
Additional hotel Amenities at the Best Western PLUS Edmonton Airport Hotel include an exercise facility, pool with water slide, hot tub, and Barney's Pub and Grill featuring a Pour Your Own Beer Wall with Alberta Craft Beers. A complimentary full hot buffet breakfast is served daily. Business, conference, banquet and ballroom facilities are also available.

Who is the CEO of Atlantica Hotels & Resorts?

Dimitris N Nicolaides is the CEO of Atlantica Hotels & Resorts. To contact Dimitris N Nicolaides email at [\[email protected\]](https://contactout.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
.

What types of accommodations does Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo Resort & Spa offer?

Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo Resort & Spa provides a variety of luxurious accommodations, including standard rooms, suites, and family rooms. Each room is designed with comfort and elegance in mind, featuring modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea. Guests can choose from options that include private balconies and upgraded suites for a more indulgent experience.

What dining options are available at the resort?

The resort boasts a diverse range of dining options to cater to all tastes. Guests can enjoy a variety of cuisines at our on-site restaurants, including Mediterranean, Italian, and international fare. We also offer themed dining nights and a selection of bars for casual drinks and snacks. Special dietary requirements can be accommodated upon request, ensuring that every guest has a delightful culinary experience.

Does Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo Resort & Spa offer any wellness services?

Yes, the resort features a comprehensive wellness center, including a full-service spa that offers a range of treatments such as massages, facials, and body therapies. Additionally, guests can take advantage of our fitness center, yoga classes, and wellness programs designed to promote relaxation and rejuvenation during their stay.

What activities and entertainment options are available for guests?

Atlantica Grand Mediterraneo Resort & Spa provides a variety of activities and entertainment options for guests of all ages. From water sports and beach games to organized excursions and cultural experiences, there is something for everyone. The resort also hosts evening entertainment, including live music and themed parties, ensuring a vibrant atmosphere throughout your stay.

Is there a kids' club or activities for children at the resort?

Yes, we offer a dedicated kids' club that provides supervised activities for children aged 4 to 12. The club features a range of fun and educational activities, including arts and crafts, games, and outdoor adventures. Our goal is to ensure that children have a memorable experience while parents enjoy some well-deserved relaxation.

How does Atlantica Hotels & Resorts prioritize customer satisfaction?

At Atlantica Hotels & Resorts, customer satisfaction is our top priority. We continuously seek feedback from our guests to improve our services and ensure that their needs are met. Our staff is trained to provide exceptional service, and we offer personalized experiences to make every guest feel valued. Whether through our concierge services or tailored amenities, we strive to exceed expectations and create unforgettable memories.
