About Corporate Billing LLC
---------------------------

Corporate Billing was started in 1995 with the purpose of providing companies the ability to leverage commercial accounts receivable to meet current cash flow needs.  
  
We fill the void between traditional banking and equity financing by advancing funds for your invoices daily, which turns your accounts receivable into instant cash.  
  
Corporate Billing has been serving clients in various industries including automotive dealers, truck dealers, repair shops, transportation, aftermarket parts, original equipment parts, equipment dealers, auto paint and supply, recycled parts, telecommunications and manufacturing since 1995.  
  
In addition, Corporate Billing provides credit and collection services as well as on-line, real-time reporting.  
  
Corporate Billing is also a proud member of the International Factoring Association (IFA).  
  
Corporate Billing’s cbCharge provides free credit to fleets while paying repair, parts and tire centers quickly. cbCharge removes all credit risk, billing, collections from the repair shop. cbCharge is a preferred vendor for NAPA AutoCare, NAPA Truck Service, NAPA Collision Centers, NAPA AUTOPRO, Jasper Engines and Transmissions, Fleet Services International, HDA Truck Pride, PTP shops and many more industry groups. www.cbCharge.com.  
  
Our highly qualified and experienced staff is committed to providing you with excellent customer service, same-day funding, and no-hidden fee products.  
  
Corporate Billing is owned by SouthState Bank, N.A. which is a public traded bank under the stock symbol SSB.  
  
We invite you to contact one of our sales representatives today at 1-877-584-3600 to learn more about our services.

About Ministère du Travail
--------------------------

Le ministère du Travail prépare et met en œuvre la politique du Gouvernement dans les domaines du travail, de l’emploi, de la formation professionnelle, du dialogue social et de la prévention des accidents du travail et des maladies professionnelles. A ce titre :Il prépare et met en œuvre les règles relatives aux conditions de travail, à la négociation collective et aux droits des salariés ; conjointement avec le ministre des affaires sociales et de la santé, il prépare et met en œuvre les règles relatives aux régimes et à la gestion des organismes de sécurité sociale en matière d’accidents du travail et de maladies professionnelles ;Il est compétent pour la défense et la promotion de l’emploi, y compris la politique de retour à l’emploi, ainsi que pour la formation professionnelle des jeunes et des adultes ;Il participe à l’action du Gouvernement en matière de lutte contre la fraude.Pour ses attributions en matière d’accidents du travail et de maladies professionnelles, il dispose de la direction de la sécurité sociale. Il dispose de la direction générale de l’Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques et, en tant que de besoin, de la délégation nationale à la lutte contre la fraude, de la direction générale de l’enseignement scolaire, du délégué à l’information et à l’orientation, du secrétariat général des ministères économique et financier et de la direction des affaires juridiques instituée par le décret du 2 novembre 1998 susvisé. Pour les questions liées aux mutations économiques, il peut disposer de la délégation interministérielle à l’aménagement du territoire et à l’attractivité régionale.

What types of security solutions does PrimeKey offer?

PrimeKey specializes in a range of IT security solutions, including Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), digital certificates, and code signing. Their offerings include EJBCA Enterprise PKI for managing digital certificates, SignServer for digital signing, and various security appliances designed to enhance data protection and trust in digital transactions.

How does PrimeKey's EJBCA Enterprise PKI benefit organizations?

EJBCA Enterprise PKI provides organizations with a robust framework for managing digital certificates and keys. It simplifies the issuance and management of certificates, enhances security through strong authentication, and supports compliance with industry standards. This solution is particularly beneficial for organizations looking to secure communications, protect sensitive data, and establish trust in their digital interactions.

What industries does PrimeKey serve with its security solutions?

PrimeKey serves a variety of industries, including government, finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Their solutions are designed to meet the unique security needs of these sectors, such as securing national ID systems, ePassport solutions, and ensuring the integrity of financial transactions through code signing and digital certificates.

Can PrimeKey's solutions be integrated with existing IT infrastructure?

Yes, PrimeKey's solutions are designed to be flexible and can be integrated with existing IT infrastructures. Whether you are using legacy systems or modern cloud-based environments, PrimeKey's products, such as EJBCA and SignServer, can be deployed to enhance your security posture without requiring a complete overhaul of your current systems.

What is the role of digital certificates in PrimeKey's offerings?

Digital certificates are a core component of PrimeKey's security solutions. They are used to establish trust between parties in digital communications, authenticate identities, and encrypt data. PrimeKey's digital certificate management solutions enable organizations to issue, renew, and revoke certificates efficiently, ensuring that their digital transactions remain secure and trustworthy.

How does PrimeKey ensure the security of its solutions?

PrimeKey employs a multi-layered security approach to protect its solutions. This includes rigorous security protocols, regular audits, compliance with industry standards, and continuous monitoring for vulnerabilities. Additionally, their expertise in PKI and digital signing ensures that their solutions are built on a foundation of strong cryptographic principles, providing a high level of security for their clients.

About PACCAR
------------

PACCAR is a global technology leader in the design, manufacture and customer support of premium light-, medium- and heavy-duty trucks under the Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF nameplates. PACCAR also designs and manufactures advanced diesel engines, provides financial services, information technology, and distributes truck parts related to its principal business.  
  
Kenworth Truck Company builds premium commercial vehicles for sale in the U.S., Canada, Mexico and Australia and for export throughout the world. Peterbilt Motors also designs, manufactures and distributes premium commercial vehicles in the US and Canada. DAF Trucks manufactures trucks in the Netherlands, Belgium, Brasil and the United Kingdom for sale throughout Western and Eastern Europe, and export to Asia, Africa, North and South America.  
  
PACCAR Parts operates a network of parts distribution centers offering aftermarket support to Kenworth, Peterbilt and DAF dealers and customers around the world. Aftermarket support includes customer call centers operating 24 hours a day throughout the year and technologically advanced systems to enhance inventory control and expedite order processing.  
  
PACCAR Financial Services provides finance, lease and insurance services to dealers and customers in 224 countries including a portfolio of more than 175,000 trucks and trailers and total assets in excess of $12 billion. The group includes PACCAR Leasing, a major full-service truck leasing company in North America, with a fleet of over 39,000 vehicles.  
  
Environmental responsibility is one of PACCAR’s core values. The company regularly develops new programs to help protect and preserve the environment and PACCAR has established ambitious goals to further reduce emissions and enhance fuel efficiency in its truck models.

About Tommy Bahama
------------------

Nearly 25 years ago, our founders started a brand based on the refined, unhurried attitude of coastal life. To our guests, Tommy Bahama soon became synonymous with laid-back style and the concept of living the Island Life.  
  
What started as a causal, upscale menswear collection quickly evolved into a unique luxury lifestyle brand. The Tommy Bahama offering has grown to include both men’s and women’s apparel, home and beach goods, and a thriving restaurant and bar business. Everything that bears the Tommy Bahama name is created with an unwavering eye towards quality.  
  
More than ever, our focus is on taking our guests someplace great — through exceptional service, upscale products, and delicious food and drinks. Maintaining our unique point of view requires a diverse team that includes apparel designers, e-commerce and technology experts, manufacturing and operations, and, of course, retail and hospitality professionals. We would love to have you share your talents with us!  
  
Tommy Bahama is part of Tommy Bahama Group, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Oxford Industries, Inc. (NYSE:OXM). Established in August 1992, with corporate headquarters in Seattle, Tommy Bahama is an island-inspired lifestyle brand that defines relaxed, sophisticated style in men’s and women’s sportswear, swimwear, accessories, footwear and a complete home furnishings collection. The company owns and operates over 160 Tommy Bahama stores worldwide, with 16 of those locations offering a Tommy Bahama restaurant & bar.  
  
Tommy Bahama products are also available at the country’s finest retailers, including Nordstrom and other specialty retailers and TommyBahama.com ships to over 100 countries. Additional stores will be opening this year. More information, please visit www.tommybahama.com.

About Work Out World
--------------------

Over the years, hundreds of thousands of New Jersey residents have become part of the Jersey Strong family. When you enter a WoW facility, you can feel the “family atmosphere” that was part of Mary Roma’s vision when she founded the first WoW in Tinton Falls back in 1992. Since then WoW has grown to one of the top 30 health clubs in the United States.  
  
The Tinton Falls location was a huge success and soon after opening, Mary’s husband Steve Sr. sold his computer leasing company and came aboard full-time as the CEO of WoW. Around the same time, Stephen Jr. was in college majoring in exercise science, and this firmly set the cornerstones in place for a successful family owned and operated business.  
  
Throughout WoW’s history and continuing today, many of the Roma family’s close friends and family can be found in various positions in the company. The closest being Stephen’s wife Heidi who is Director of Retail Sales and the Chairperson of WoW’s foundation called the Jersey Strong Foundation.  
  
WoW is all about people – members and staff alike. The WoW formula for success is a simple one. Provide members with large state-of-the-art facilities and offer a world-class variety of guided exercise options that are delivered by the best fitness professionals in New Jersey.  
  
It’s this sense of connection and commitment to quality that makes WoW a health club like no other.

What services does Smashwords offer to indie authors?

Smashwords provides a comprehensive suite of services for indie authors, including free ebook publishing and distribution to major retailers and libraries. Authors can format their manuscripts using the Smashwords Style Guide, upload their ebooks, and set their own pricing. Additionally, Smashwords offers marketing tools, such as coupon codes and preorders, to help authors promote their work effectively.

How does Smashwords distribute ebooks to retailers?

Smashwords distributes ebooks to a wide range of retailers and platforms, including Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, and libraries through OverDrive and Baker & Taylor. Once an author uploads their ebook to Smashwords, it is automatically formatted and sent to these distribution partners, allowing authors to reach a global audience without the need for multiple submissions.

Is there a cost associated with publishing an ebook through Smashwords?

No, Smashwords does not charge authors any fees for publishing or distributing their ebooks. The platform is completely free to use, allowing authors to retain 100% of their royalties. Smashwords earns a small percentage of sales as a commission, but authors can set their own prices and control their earnings.

What types of content can I publish on Smashwords?

Smashwords accepts a wide variety of content, including fiction, non-fiction, poetry, and essays. Authors can publish any genre, from romance and science fiction to self-help and educational materials. However, all content must comply with Smashwords' content guidelines, which prohibit illegal or offensive material.

Can I track my ebook sales and performance on Smashwords?

Yes, Smashwords provides authors with a detailed dashboard that tracks ebook sales, downloads, and royalties in real-time. Authors can view sales data by retailer, format, and time period, allowing them to analyze their performance and adjust their marketing strategies accordingly.

What resources does Smashwords provide for authors looking to improve their ebook marketing?

Smashwords offers a variety of resources to help authors enhance their ebook marketing efforts. This includes a blog with tips on marketing strategies, access to promotional tools like coupon codes and author interviews, and participation in the Smashwords Read an Ebook Week event. Additionally, authors can join the Smashwords community to share experiences and learn from one another.

About New England Herpetological Society
----------------------------------------

The New England Herpetological Society is a group of reptile and amphibian enthusiasts. Our goals are education, conservation and the advancement of herpetology. Society members have unique opportunities to further their knowledge of and participation in all aspects of herpetology.  
  
Originally known as the Massachusetts Herpetological Society, it was founded in 1972. As the membership base began to expand beyond the borders of Massachusetts, we changed our name to the New England Herpetological Society.  
  
The New England Herpetological Society is a registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.  
  
Our goals:  
To promote the discovery and dissemination of amphibian and reptile information.  
To encourage the specific study of amphibians and reptiles.  
To encourage the conservation of amphibians and reptiles, as well as wildlife in general.  
To stimulate fellowship among herpetologists and herp enthusiasts throughout New England.  
  
Experience the joy of reptiles! Whether you are already a reptile enthusiast, fascinated by these exotic creatures or just a little bit curious, you are welcome to join us at one of our monthly meetings!. With so few reptile organizations in the New England area, our meetings provide an opportunity for people of all ages to learn, touch and observe all kinds of amphibians and reptiles. In addition, meetings provide the means to adopt or purchase reptiles and amphibians.  
  
The Society meets monthly at the New England Wildlife Center in Weymouth, Massachusetts

About H-ISAC
------------

Health-ISAC (Health Information Sharing and Analysis Center), is a global, non-profit, member-driven organization where health sector stakeholders join a trusted community and forum for coordinating, collaborating and sharing vital physical and cyber threat intelligence and best practices with each other. Members use this information to extend their security operations team and to create situational awareness, inform risk-based decision-making and mitigate against threats. Membership is open to public & private hospitals, ambulatory providers, health insurance payers, pharmaceutical/biotech manufacturers, laboratory, diagnostic, medical device manufacturers, medical schools, medical R&D organizations and other relevant health sector stakeholders. Member organizations become more resilient by working together, benefiting the entire health sector and its vital role in critical infrastructure worldwide.

HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!  
  
From our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub Berlin, we’re evolving from the world’s leading meal kit company to the world's leading food solutions group. We delivered 243.3 million meals and reached 7.5 million active customers around the world in Q3 2022.  
  
HelloFresh Group consists of six brands that provide customers with high quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Every ingredient needed for our meals are carefully planned, responsibly sourced and delivered to your door when it’s most convenient for you. Only HelloFresh gives you the tools to achieve something delicious every day.  
  
Making a meal a delicious achievement - not just fuel for your day - takes a lot of work and smart people. From Designers and Copywriters to Data Scientists and DevOps Engineers, to potato farmers, pasta makers and the people who ensure every box is perfectly packed for every customer, we’re collectively disrupting the food supply chain and the multi-trillion-dollar food tech industry.  
  
Our more than 21,000 high-performing and ambitious employees across the globe from New York to Berlin, London to Sydney and Toronto to Milan enjoy a number of benefits including flexible working arrangements, discounts on our boxes, health and well-being and learning and development programs.

Basingstoke Sports Trust is a not-for-profit, charitable leisure organisation established over 40 years ago in 1970. The Trust is independent and owns and manages Basingstoke Sports Centre at Festival Place.  
  
The Trust is dedicated to providing local communities with the opportunity to take part in physical activity and health and wellbeing programmes. We have a wide range of sport and leisure facilities and services at the Centre and we are keen to work with partners to expand our offer into other community-based settings.  
  
We have specialist expertise in managing and delivering health and wellbeing programmes including Cardiac Rehabilitation and Exercise Referral and are now working with partners to broaden our current scope.  
  
We are also able to work with partners to maximise the use of their sporting and leisure facilities and are particularly keen to hear from schools and colleges who are thinking about opening their facilities up to the public during extra-curricular time to generate new income streams.  
  
Likewise, we are developing a health and fitness model that can be incorporated into existing hotels and golf clubs and would welcome a no-obligation discussion should this be something you may wish to consider.

What types of businesses can benefit from Blue Layer's IT consulting services?

Blue Layer's IT consulting services are designed to support a wide range of businesses, from small startups to large enterprises. Our focus on 'Right Sized' IT means that we tailor our solutions to fit the specific needs and scale of your organization. Whether you are looking for cloud computing solutions, disaster recovery plans, or IT management strategies, we can help optimize your technology to enhance efficiency and drive growth.

How does Blue Layer approach cloud computing solutions?

At Blue Layer, we understand that cloud computing is not a one-size-fits-all solution. Our team works closely with you to assess your current infrastructure and business goals, allowing us to recommend the most suitable cloud solutions, whether it's public, private, or hybrid cloud. We ensure that your cloud environment is secure, scalable, and aligned with your operational needs, helping you leverage the full potential of cloud technology.

What is the significance of a Technology Maturity Assessment?

A Technology Maturity Assessment is a critical evaluation of your organization's current technology capabilities and processes. At Blue Layer, we conduct a thorough analysis to identify strengths, weaknesses, and areas for improvement. This assessment helps you understand where you stand in terms of technology adoption and maturity, enabling you to make informed decisions about future investments and strategies that align with your business objectives.

Can Blue Layer assist with disaster recovery planning?

Yes, Blue Layer specializes in disaster recovery planning to ensure that your business can quickly recover from unexpected disruptions. We work with you to develop a comprehensive disaster recovery strategy that includes data backup solutions, failover processes, and business continuity planning. Our goal is to minimize downtime and protect your critical data, so you can maintain operations even in the face of challenges.

What industries does Blue Layer serve?

Blue Layer serves a diverse range of industries, including healthcare, finance, education, manufacturing, and retail. Our expertise in IT consulting allows us to provide tailored solutions that address the unique challenges and regulatory requirements of each sector. Whether you need unified communications, virtualization, or IT monitoring, we have the experience and knowledge to support your industry-specific needs.

What are the benefits of using Blue Layer's VoIP and Hosted Exchange services?

Blue Layer's VoIP and Hosted Exchange services offer numerous benefits, including cost savings, improved communication, and enhanced collaboration. VoIP allows for flexible and scalable phone solutions that can adapt to your business's growth, while Hosted Exchange provides reliable email services with advanced security features. Together, these services streamline communication, reduce operational costs, and improve overall productivity for your organization.

Sama Eyewear is the world's finest and most exclusive ultra-premium eyewear company. Founded by internationally renowned designer Sheila Vance, Sama Eyewear introduced the world to luxury fashion eyewear and remains the standard by which all others are judged. Always on the cutting edge, Sama Eyewear is proud of its many design and technology firsts including the introduction of 100% Pure Titanium to the optical industry.

What types of eyewear does Sama Eyewear offer?

Sama Eyewear specializes in ultra-premium designer eyewear, offering a wide range of products including luxury sunglasses and ophthalmic glasses. What is the Sama Lens Provider (SLP) program?

Where can I purchase Sama Eyewear products?

About IPG Photonics
-------------------

IPG Photonics is the world leader in high-power fiber lasers, fiber amplifiers, hybrid fiber/solid-state lasers and diode lasers for use in a wide range of markets including materials processing, advanced technologies, telecommunications & medical applications. IPG manufactures fiber lasers operating at 0.5 – 5 microns. IPG’s 1um and 1.5um fiber lasers and amplifiers are particularly popular in single-frequency and linearly-polarized variants; providing products having the best available combination of performance, reliability and price. IPG's newly developed 2-5 microns mid-IR lasers offer cost-effective solutions for sensing, spectroscopy, material processing & medical applications.  
  
Founded in 1990, IPG Photonics pioneered the development and commercialization of optical fiber-based lasers, a new generation of lasers that combine the advantages of semiconductor diodes with the high amplification and precise beam qualities of specialty optical fibers. Fiber lasers deliver superior performance, reliability and usability at a lower total cost of ownership than conventional lasers and 15x more energy efficient than conventional lasers.  
  
IPG's fully vertically integrated manufacturing process provides significant competitive advantages and enhances its ability to meet customer requirements, manage costs and improve performance. IPG Photonics is headquartered in Oxford, MA with additional manufacturing and application facilities worldwide including Germany, Italy, and Russia.

About 1880 Bank
---------------

We are a locally operated independent community bank. We take great pride in carrying on the rich heritage and traditions of the region by providing real support to the community, through our world class financial services and employees' volunteerism. 1880 Bank has served Dorchester County and the Eastern Shore of Maryland for over 130 years. Originally known as The National Bank of Cambridge, 1880 Bank is stronger than ever as the result of its dedicated team of banking executives who have guided the institution toward a positive financial future. The bank has six conveniently located branch offices on Maryland’s Eastern Shore and now serves Delaware through online banking services.  
  
“Our new name reflects our local Dorchester County roots but also gives us the flexibility to grow and expand elsewhere on the Shore,” said Kim C. Liddell, Chairman, President and CEO of Delmarva Bancshares, Inc. and 1880 Bank. “In the past four years, we have grown deeper relationships with businesses and individuals in Caroline, Cecil, Kent, Queen Anne’s, Talbot and Wicomico counties, and we believe there is an opportunity for further growth throughout the Delmarva Peninsula.”  
  
Our success is driven by the local team of employees who deliver professional, hometown service and who provide a strong, safe and sound bank for you to do business with in person or online. We are committed to helping our community preserve its wonderful history and our top priority will always be to offer the best services available safely and securely to the businesses and citizens of the communities we serve.

About Naturalia France
----------------------

Naturalia a toujours été précurseur. En 1973, en ouvrant son 1er magasin boulevard Magenta à Paris pour offrir aux citadins une alimentation plus saine, grâce à une sélection de produits biologiques, diététiques et naturels de qualité. About Axon
----------

The Axon Story  
Our story began in September of 1993 when TASER International was founded by CEO Rick Smith with his brother Tom Smith. They consulted with Jack Cover, former NASA scientist and inventor of the original TASER® conduct- ed energy weapons of the 1970s. Rick Smith was inspired to found the company after losing two high school football teammates who were shot and killed in a road rage incident. This experience led him to seek new technol- ogies that would enable people to protect themselves without deploying lethal force in hopes of creating a bullet-less world.  
Today, Axon represents the entire network of devices, applications and people that is revolutionizing public safety around the world. Our mission is to protect life. We’re building the world’s largest and most trusted suite of public safety solutions. If you are seeking a career with purpose, we invite you to join us.  
Learn more at: axon.com/careers  
  
This is Our Moonshot  
Gun-related deaths between police and the public have risen steadily for at least the past six years. In 2021 in the U.S., 1,118 people — 1,054 civilians and 64 officers — lost their lives in gun-related incidents between police and the public, according to leading data sources. In response, Axon is rallying partners around a “moonshot” goal to cut gun-related deaths between police and the public by 50% in 10 years.

Grimaldi Forum Monaco offers a comprehensive range of services to support event organizers, including event planning assistance, technical support, catering services, and on-site logistics management. Is Grimaldi Forum Monaco accessible for individuals with disabilities?

Yes, Grimaldi Forum Monaco is committed to providing an inclusive environment for all guests. The venue is fully accessible for individuals with disabilities, featuring ramps, elevators, and designated seating areas. Additionally, staff members are trained to assist guests with special needs to ensure a comfortable experience.

Can Grimaldi Forum Monaco accommodate large international conferences?

Absolutely! Grimaldi Forum Monaco is well-equipped to host large international conferences, with flexible spaces that can accommodate thousands of attendees. The venue's central location in Monaco, combined with its state-of-the-art facilities and services, makes it an ideal choice for high-profile events and gatherings.

What cultural events are typically held at Grimaldi Forum Monaco?

Grimaldi Forum Monaco hosts a variety of cultural events, including art exhibitions, concerts, theater performances, and film festivals. The venue is known for its commitment to promoting cultural exchange and artistic expression, making it a vibrant hub for both local and international artists.

How can I book a space at Grimaldi Forum Monaco for my event?

They will guide you through the booking process, discuss your event requirements, and provide you with a tailored proposal to suit your needs.

Today, the company still makes hand-crafted shoes in Texas to exacting standards with the very best materials available, making its own shoe forms so that it can offer an unparalleled fit—73 sizes for women and 89 for men—and astonishing comfort. Carried in 200+ SAS stores and over 1,500 retailers in the United States, Canada, Mexico, Australia, Korea, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Israel—the San Antonio Shoemakers brand is a humble American success story, and continues to be a family-owned enterprise driven by an obsession with fit and quality. About Hudson Institute
----------------------

Hudson Institute is a non-partisan policy research organization dedicated to innovative research and analysis that promotes global security, prosperity, and freedom.  
  
Hudson Institute challenges conventional thinking and helps manage strategic transitions to the future through interdisciplinary and collaborative studies in defense, international relations, economics, culture, science, technology, and law. Through publications, conferences and policy recommendations, we seek to guide global leaders in government and business.  
  
Since our founding in 1961 by the futurist Herman Kahn, Hudson’s perspective has been uniquely future-oriented and optimistic. Our research has stood the test of time in a world dramatically transformed by the collapse of the Soviet Union, the rise of China, and the advent of radicalism within Islam. Because Hudson sees the complexities within societies, we focus on the often-overlooked interplay among culture, demography, technology, markets, and political leadership.  
  
Our broad-based approach has, for decades, allowed us to present well-timed recommendations to leaders in government and business, domestically as well as abroad. Hudson Institute has grown steadily-both in prestige and resources-from its origins in Croton-on-Hudson, to its tenure in Indianapolis, and now as a leading international policy organization with offices in Washington and New York.  
  
In the 1970s, Hudson’s scholars helped turn the world away from the no-growth policies of the Club of Rome; in the early 1990s, we helped the newly-liberated Baltic nations become booming market economies; at home, we helped write the pioneering Wisconsin welfare reform law that became the model for successful national welfare reform in the mid-1990s. Today, as part of our research agenda, we are developing programs of political and economic reform to transform the Muslim world.

WebPurify empowers communities to be their best with scalable hybrid AI and human content moderation solutions for the world’s leading brands. Ensuring positive user experiences for millions of customers, from marketplaces to the metaverse, with multimedia content seamlessly filtered to any brand’s specifications.  
  
WebPurify provides content moderation and review services using both teams of human content moderators and AI solutions. By combining our AI tools with live teams, we are able to offer brands the most accurate content moderation available: 24 hours a day, seven days a week. Whatever your business needs, we have a solution for you.  
  
With more than 16 years in the content moderation business, we have worked with diverse brands across e-commerce, financial services, dating, gaming and VR, ad agencies, social media platforms, image hosting, food and beverage and product customization to ensure brands’ communities are safe, and that brand reputation is protected.

\-Profanity Filtering and Text Moderation  
\-Image Moderation  
\-Video Review and Moderation, Annotation, Keywording, Categorization, Tagging, -Licensing Compliance  
\-VR Moderation  
\-Online Community Standards and Terms of Service Enforcement  
  
Our content moderation solutions help brands meet all regulatory compliance and can handle the complex needs of multiple platforms with market-leading accuracy. We moderate 3.5 million text submissions, half a million images and thousands of videos every day.  
  
Our mission is to provide a seamless, scalable and reliable way for brands to safeguard their customers’ experiences on all digital platforms.

About Washington State China Relations Council
----------------------------------------------

The Washington State China Relations Council (WSCRC) is the leading organization engaged in China-related activity in Washington state. Founded in 1979 following the normalization of diplomatic relations between the United States and China, WSCRC a private and non-profit business association dedicated to promoting stronger commercial, educational, and cultural relations between the state of Washington and the People's Republic of China. The Council is the longest-running non-governmental statewide trade association in the United States focused on China.  
  
It provides trade support, information and service to many of Washington State's leading corporations, from large firms that have built significant operations in China to small companies that are in the process of breaking into the Chinese market.  
  
WSCRC members are part of a broad alliance of Washington businesses, academic institutions and cultural organizations that have significant interest in China.

Sunrun, headquartered in San Francisco, California, is a leading residential solar energy provider dedicated to empowering homeowners with clean, renewable energy solutions. With a mission to put control, simplicity, and possibility in the hands of every individual, Sunrun aims to revolutionize the way people connect with sustainable energy sources. The company primarily serves the residential sector, offering a range of products and services designed to make solar energy accessible and affordable.  
  
Sunrun specializes in solar panel installation, energy storage solutions, and innovative financing options, enabling homeowners to harness the power of the sun while reducing their reliance on traditional energy sources. Their cutting-edge technology includes high-efficiency solar panels and smart energy management systems that optimize energy usage and storage. By utilizing solar power, customers can significantly lower their electricity bills and contribute to a cleaner environment.  
  
In addition to solar panel installations, Sunrun offers battery storage solutions, allowing homeowners to store excess energy generated during the day for use during peak hours or power outages. This not only enhances energy independence but also supports grid stability. The company’s commitment to customer satisfaction is evident in its comprehensive service offerings, which include system monitoring, maintenance, and support.  
  
As a pioneer in the solar industry, Sunrun is at the forefront of the clean energy movement, driving innovation and sustainability. By making solar energy accessible to all, Sunrun is helping to create a greener future, one home at a time.

About Universidad de Quintana Roo
---------------------------------

La Universidad de Quintana Roo,es un organismo descentralizado del Estado de Quintana Roo, de interés público y social, con personalidad jurídica y patrimonio propios.  
  
Las unidades académicas con las que cuenta actualmente son:  
Unidad Académica Chetumal,  
Unidad Académica Cozumel,  
Unidad Académica Playa del Carmen.  
  
  
Misión  
Formar profesionistas comprometidos con el progreso del ser humano y el amor a la patria, a través de un modelo educativo integral que mediante diferentes modalidades de enseñanza-aprendizaje fomente y desarrolle valores, actitudes y habilidades que les permitan integrarse al desarrollo social y económico en un ambiente competitivo; generar y aplicar conocimientos útiles e innovadores en una vigorosa vinculación con la sociedad; perservar los acervos científicos, culturales y naturales; intercambiar conocimientos y recursos con instituciones nacionales e internacionales para aprovechar las oportunidades generadas en el mundo, con la firme intención de contribuir al desarrollo sustentable, así como al fortalecimiento de la cultura e indentidad de Quintana Roo y de México.  
  
Descripción  
La Universidad de Quintana Roo es un centro académico dedicada a formar profesionistas. Su creación responde a un viejo anhelo de los Quintanarroenses de contar con un centro de educación superior para formar profesionales en las áreas sociales, las humanidades, las ciencias básicas y las áreas tecnológicas de mayor demanda y consumo en esta época de alta competitividad.

About Seeking Alpha
-------------------

Seeking Alpha is the world’s largest investing community. Powered by the wisdom and diversity of crowdsourcing, millions of investors connect to discover and share investing ideas, discuss breaking news, debate the merits of stocks, and make informed investment decisions. 17 million people use Seeking Alpha every month.  
  
Seeking Alpha has unparalleled breadth and depth: from stocks, ETFs and mutual funds to commodities and cryptocurrency, including thousands of stocks (such as small-caps) not analyzed elsewhere. Written by investors for investors, more than 7,000 contributors publish 10,000 investing ideas every month. Each thesis undergoes a rigorous editorial review, ensuring the highest quality standards. A healthy debate ensues, as investors all over the world discuss and share their thoughts and ideas.  
  
Seeking Alpha levels the playing field by putting exclusive tools, until now available only to Wall Street professionals, into the hands of individual investors. Advanced charting, data visualizations, technical and fundamental analysis add clarity and enable informed, data-driven decision-making.  
  
Seeking Alpha provides investors with breaking news, analysis and newsletters to follow their investments and the market. We also have a suite of subscription plans that address specific investing styles and user needs.  
  
Premium unlocks 1 million investing ideas and valuable features such as Author, Quant, and Dividend Ratings, data visualizations, and the ability to track the performance of authors’ past ideas.  
  
PRO+ is Seeking Alpha’s profit accelerator for HNWIs and professional investors. PRO+ includes all Premium features plus Top Ideas from top-performing authors, exclusive short ideas, and VIP service.  
  
Marketplace is a collection of investing experts with unique investing styles. Each Marketplace service is its own community offering a curated journey, exclusive research, investing ideas, direct contact with the marketplace leaders, and a dedicated chat room.

What types of programs does Kids Klub offer for early childhood education?

Kids Klub offers a variety of programs tailored to meet the developmental needs of children at different stages. Our primary offerings include preschool programs designed for children aged 3-5, which focus on foundational skills in literacy, numeracy, and social interaction. We also provide infant care for younger children, ensuring a nurturing environment for infants up to 24 months. Additionally, we have after-school care programs for school-aged children, which include homework assistance and recreational activities.

Are there any extra-curricular classes available at Kids Klub?

Yes, Kids Klub offers a range of extra-curricular classes that cater to various interests and talents. These classes may include art, music, dance, and sports, allowing children to explore their creativity and develop new skills outside of the standard curriculum. Our goal is to provide a well-rounded experience that fosters both academic and personal growth.

What are the operating hours for Kids Klub's evening and weekend programs?

Kids Klub understands the diverse schedules of families, which is why we offer flexible evening and weekend programs. Our evening programs typically run from 5 PM to 9 PM on weekdays, while weekend programs are available from 9 AM to 5 PM on Saturdays. These programs are designed to provide additional care and enrichment opportunities for children, making it easier for parents to manage their work-life balance.

How does Kids Klub ensure the safety and well-being of children in their care?

Our facilities are designed with child safety in mind, featuring age-appropriate equipment and supervised play areas. Additionally, we maintain a low child-to-staff ratio to ensure that each child receives personalized attention and care.

What is the enrollment process for new families at Kids Klub?

Once you decide to enroll, we will provide you with all necessary forms and information regarding tuition, schedules, and what to bring on your child's first day.

Does Kids Klub offer summer camps, and what activities are included?

Yes, Kids Klub offers exciting summer camps that provide children with a fun and engaging environment during the summer months. Our summer camps include a variety of activities such as arts and crafts, sports, outdoor adventures, and educational field trips. Each week features a different theme, allowing children to explore new interests and make lasting friendships. Our camps are designed to be both fun and enriching, ensuring that children have a memorable summer experience.

Mount Holyoke College, located in South Hadley, Massachusetts, is a distinguished institution founded in 1837, dedicated to empowering women through a rigorous liberal arts education. As the leading gender-diverse women’s college, Mount Holyoke fosters an intellectually adventurous global community, where approximately 2,200 students engage in a transformative educational experience. The college emphasizes the development of individual voices and visions, preparing students for purposeful leadership in an ever-evolving world.  
  
The vibrant campus is steeped in over 180 years of tradition, yet it boldly embraces innovation and diversity. Students benefit from a rich array of academic programs, supported by a dedicated faculty committed to excellence in teaching and mentorship. The Mount Holyoke College teachers list showcases a diverse group of scholars and practitioners who bring a wealth of knowledge and experience to the classroom, fostering an environment of inquiry and collaboration.  
  
Beyond academics, Mount Holyoke encourages students to engage in various extracurricular activities, community service, and leadership opportunities, all aimed at cultivating a sense of social responsibility and global awareness. The college's commitment to inclusivity and empowerment ensures that every student has the resources and support needed to thrive. As they prepare to lead in a complex world, Mount Holyoke graduates emerge as confident, capable leaders ready to make a meaningful impact. For more information about the college and its vibrant community, visit their official website at \[Mount Holyoke College\](https://www.mtholyoke.edu/).

About U.S. Office of Personnel Management (OPM)
-----------------------------------------------

We lead and serve the Federal Government in enterprise human resources management by delivering policies and services to achieve a trusted effective civilian workforce.  
  
OPM serves as the chief human resources agency and personnel policy manager for the Federal Government. We provide human resources leadership and support to Federal agencies and help the Federal workforce achieve their aspirations as they serve the American people. OPM directs human resources and employee management services, administers retirement benefits, manages healthcare and insurance programs, oversees merit-based and inclusive hiring into the civil service, and provides a secure employment process.  
  
\===  
In order to better serve its stakeholders, OPM utilizes user engagement tools on OPM-hosted sites, such as blogs on OPM.gov, as tools for communicating with applicable stakeholders. To protect your privacy and the privacy of others, please do not include your social security number, case numbers, or any other sensitive personally identifiable information (PII) in your comments or responses on OPM-hosted communications tools. In addition, please do not include others’ social security numbers, case numbers, or any other sensitive personally identifiable information (PII). Our OPM-hosted communications outlets, such as blogs on OPM.gov, should not be considered secure; sensitive or personally identifiable information (PII) should not be shared on these platforms or tools. If you have specific questions regarding an OPM activity or program that involves details you do not wish to share publicly, please contact the program point of contact listed at https://www.opm.gov/aboutus/contact-us/.  
  
We reserve the discretion to hide, delete or not allow comments violate our comment policy.  
  
To view our comment policy and our entire Social Media Policy please visit www.opm.gov

In addition, the company runs a digital marketing business which serves advertising clients throughout the Southeast, a film production group Advance Originals, and the national brands Reckon and It’s a Southern Thing.  
  
We have more than 100 journalists who are dedicated to telling stories that change lives, laws and minds across our digital brands right here in Alabama. And our work continues to earn national recognition for its impact and innovation.

Alabama Media Group is part of Advance Local Media and owned by Advance, owners of Conde’ Nast; and shareholders in Reddit, Warner Bros. Discovery and Charter Communications.  
  
One of the largest media groups in the United States, Advance operates the leading news and information companies in more than 20 cities, reaching 58+ million people, including MLive Media Group, Advance Ohio, NJ Advance Media, Advance Media NY, MassLive Media, Oregonian Media Group, PA Media Group and Staten Island Media Group.

About Ritual G
--------------

We are the gym for busy people  
  
You know you need to exercise, so why not get it done as efficiently as possible? If you do it right (and our friendly coaches will show you how), you can get a safe, high-quality and effective workout and be out the door in half an hour. Science says so. With small group classes running all day long and everything you need provided, all you need to do is just find a little time in your busy day and show up.  
\====  
  
EFFECTIVE  
We've read the research, and 20 minutes of HIIT has been repeatedly shown to be far more effective than an hour of consistent effort on a bike or a treadmill. If you can just ask a little bit more from your body than it can handle, you can raise your metabolic rate for up to 48 hours after your training session. If you want to burn fat whilst watching TV, HIIT is the way to do it.  
  
PERSONALIZED  
We've got 4 levels of progression, so whether you're a high level athlete or stepping into a gym for the first time, we've got you covered. There's no 'one size fits all' when it comes to fitness, so our coaches are trained to adjust the daily programs according to your specific needs. This means you always get an individualized experience that works for you.  
  
SAFE  
At Ritual, we focus on form over reps, because not only will you get more out of doing 5 perfect reps than 15 poorly-executed ones, you' re far less likely to injure yourself in the process. With just 10 clients per session, you'll always get high-quality coaching with lots of personal attention, within a fun, supportive environment.  
  
No treadmills, No scales, No nonsense.  
Just Results.

What types of fitness programs does Ritual Gym offer?

Ritual Gym specializes in high-intensity interval training (HIIT) programs designed for busy individuals. Our offerings include group classes, personal training sessions, and online workout plans that can be tailored to fit your schedule. We focus on maximizing efficiency to ensure you get the most out of your workout in a limited timeframe.

How does Ritual Gym cater to busy professionals?

Ritual Gym understands the challenges faced by busy professionals, which is why our programs are designed to be time-efficient and flexible. We offer short, effective workouts that can be completed in as little as 30 minutes, along with options for virtual training. Additionally, our facilities are equipped with everything you need to get in and out quickly, allowing you to fit exercise into your hectic lifestyle.

Can I join Ritual Gym if I am a beginner?

Absolutely! Ritual Gym welcomes individuals of all fitness levels, including beginners. Our trainers are experienced in creating personalized workout plans that cater to your current fitness level and goals. We also provide guidance on proper techniques and modifications to ensure you feel comfortable and confident as you progress.

What is the franchise model for Ritual Gym?

Ritual Gym offers a franchise model for those interested in opening their own location. Our franchise program provides comprehensive support, including training, marketing, and operational guidance. How can I track my progress at Ritual Gym?

About World Bank Group
----------------------

The World Bank Group is a multilateral organization headquartered in Washington, D.C., whose members include most of the world’s countries. Five institutions make up the World Bank Group to collectively serve as a vital source of financial and technical assistance to developing countries.  
  
We have set two goals that will shape our work through 2030:  
\- Ending extreme poverty by decreasing the percentage of people living on less than $1.25 a day to no more than 3 percent.  
\- Promoting shared prosperity by fostering income growth of the bottom 40 percent for every country.  
  
We are tackling these challenges through financing, customizing development solutions, leveraging knowledge, research and technology, and by bringing people together to solve complex problems.  
  
The five institutions that make up the World Bank Group work together to foster development in poor and middle-income countries and to confront such global challenges as climate change.  
\- The International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD) or World Bank, tackles poverty in middle-income and creditworthy low-income countries.  
\- The International Development Association (IDA), also part of the World Bank, provides interest-free loans, technical assistance, and policy advice to governments in the world’s poorest countries.  
\- The International Finance Corporation (IFC) is the largest global development institution focused exclusively on the private sector. IFC finances investment, mobilizes capital in international financial markets, and provides advisory services to businesses and governments.  
\- The Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) promotes foreign direct investment into developing countries. MIGA fulfills this mandate by offering political risk insurance and credit enhancement to investors and lenders.  
\- The International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes (ICSID) provides international facilities for conciliation and arbitration of investment disputes.

About Commentary, Inc.
----------------------

COMMENTARY is America’s premier monthly magazine of opinion and a pivotal voice in American intellectual life. Since its inception in 1945, and increasingly after it emerged as the flagship of neoconservatism in the 1970’s, the magazine has been consistently engaged with several large, interrelated questions: the fate of democracy and of democratic ideas in a world threatened by totalitarian ideologies; the state of American and Western security; the future of the Jews, Judaism, and Jewish culture in Israel, the United States, and around the world; and the preservation of high culture in an age of political correctness and the collapse of critical standards.  
  
Many of COMMENTARY’s articles have been controversial, and more than a few have been hugely influential, touchstones for debate and discussion in universities, among policy analysts in and out of government, within the ranks of professionals and community activists of all kinds, and in circles of serious thought worldwide. A large number of articles can be counted as landmarks of American letters and intellectual life. Agree with it or disagree with it, COMMENTARY cannot be ignored. To read it is to take part in the great American discussion.

About Prison Arts Collective
----------------------------

Prison Arts Collective (PAC) is headquartered at San Diego State University, with partnerships with California State Universities; CSU San Bernardino, CSU Fullerton, & Humboldt State University. PAC provides multidisciplinary arts programming, facilitator training for incarcerated peer leaders, and guest artist workshops to people inside California state prisons. PAC utilizes collaborative teaching teams that include university faculty and students, staff teaching artists, guest artists, and currently and formerly incarcerated peer leaders. The PAC model emphasizes co-creating a safe space for creating art and community. Each class includes art history, creative practice, and reflection. PAC offers a vibrant and effective approach to rehabilitation that integrates principles of restorative justice through a rich and diverse lens on art making and art history.  
  
PAC is supported by Arts in Corrections, a partnership between the California Arts Council and California Department of Corrections and Rehabilitation

About Sunny Bono

Sonny Bono was a prominent American entertainer and politician who had a rich and varied career in both the entertainment industry and public service. Born Salvatore Phillip Bono on February 16, 1935, in Detroit, Michigan, he rose to fame as part of the musical duo Sonny & Cher, alongside his then-wife Cher. As an entertainer, Bono was known for his distinctive voice, charismatic stage presence, and catchy, pop-oriented songs. However, he is also remembered for his successful transition into politics, serving as the mayor of Palm Springs, California, and later as a United States Representative for California's 44th congressional district.  
  
Bono's music career began in the early 1960s when he met Cher, and the two formed a musical partnership that would eventually lead to international stardom. As Sonny & Cher, the duo released a string of hit singles, including "I Got You Babe," "The Beat Goes On," and "All I Ever Need Is You." Their unique blend of folk rock and pop music captured the spirit of the times and earned them a dedicated fan base. Bono's distinctive look, with his shaggy hair and signature mustache, also helped to cement his image in the public consciousness.  
  
In addition to his work as a musician, Bono pursued various business ventures and acting opportunities, further establishing his reputation as a multi-talented entertainer. He also delved into politics, serving as the mayor of Palm Springs from 1988 to 1992. During his mayoral tenure, Bono focused on revitalizing the city's downtown area and promoting tourism, helping to solidify Palm Springs as a popular destination for visitors and residents alike. His success as mayor laid the groundwork for his future political ambitions.  
  
In 1994, Bono made the leap from local to national politics when he ran for a seat in the United States House of Representatives. Running as a Republican, he won the election and began his tenure as a congressman representing California's 44th congressional district. Bono's time in Congress was marked by his dedication to advocating for issues important to his constituents, including supporting small business growth, improving education, and strengthening the economy. Despite being a newcomer to national politics, Bono quickly made a name for himself as a diligent and passionate legislator.  
  
Tragically, Bono's political career was cut short when he died in a skiing accident on January 5, 1998, at the age of 62. His sudden passing sent shockwaves through the political and entertainment worlds, as colleagues and fans mourned the loss of a beloved figure. Bono's legacy continues to be remembered and honored, with his contributions to both the entertainment industry and public service leaving a lasting impact on American culture.  
  
In retrospect, Sonny Bono's journey from entertainer to politician stands as a testament to his determination and versatility. His ability to excel in multiple fields, from music to business to public service, reflects his unwavering commitment to making a positive impact on the world around him. Whether he was captivating audiences with his music or advocating for policies in Congress, Bono's passion for bringing people together and improving communities was evident in everything he did. Though his life was tragically cut short, his influence endures, and he remains a respected and admired figure in American history.

The firm is led by general partners, many of whom are former founders/operators, CEOs, or CTOs of successful technology companies, and who have domain expertise ranging from biology to crypto to distributed systems to security to marketplaces to financial services.We aim to connect entrepreneurs, investors, executives, engineers, academics, industry experts, and others in the technology ecosystem. About Ramirent Finland Oy
-------------------------

Ramirent vuokraa koneita ja laitteita sekä tarjoaa niihin liittyviä palveluja rakentajille ja remontoijille sekä teollisuudelle. Ramirent on Suomen suurin rakennuskonevuokraamo: Yli 50 toimipistettä, joissa palvelee yli 550 luotettavaa ammattilaista, sekä markkinoiden laajin tuotevalikoima takaavat asiakkaillemme toimivat ja luotettavat vuokrauspalvelut. Vuokraamoverkostomme kattaa koko Suomen.  
  
Ramirentin päätuoteryhmiä ovat erilaiset ammattikäyttöön tarkoitetut rakennustyökoneet, henkilönostimet, telineet, betonointimuotit, työmaatilat sekä torninosturit ja hissit. Tarjoamme tuotteisiimme liittyen myös suunnittelu-, asennus-, kuljetus- ja neuvontapalveluja.  
  
Asiakaskuntamme koostuu mm. rakennus- ja asennusliikkeistä, teollisuuslaitoksista, telakoista, valtion ja kuntien organisaatioista sekä yksityishenkilöistä. Vuokraaminen on taloudellinen ja nykyaikainen ratkaisu, joka ei aiheuta korjaus- ja huoltokustannuksia. Vuokraamalla pääomia ei sitoudu kalliisiin koneisiin, joiden tehokas käyttöaika on usein lyhyt, vaan rahaa vapautuu muihin hankintoihin. Vuokraaminen antaa myös parhaan mahdollisuuden valita aina kuhunkin käyttökohteeseen parhaiten soveltuvat koneet ja laiteet.

About The Pavilion
------------------

Our extensive Home & Garden Store, Restaurant & Bakery is based in Ballygarvan. The Pavilion Commercial Landscaping Center is located close by; just minutes from Cork airport. The Pavilion also specialises in Specimen Plants & Trees for commerical and domestic projects. Our online store features Home Interiors/Furniture, Garden Furniture, Specimen Plants. We are official stockists of Weber BBQ equipment. We have won numerous national awards for the garden centre and landscaping and are recognised within our industry for quality, innovation, honesty and integrity.  
  
At the Pavilion all emphasis is on quality. The Pavilion Garden Centre and Landscaping service will take your aspirations, add our expertise and create an outdoor experience that reflects the standards and values of your company. We take your ideas as a starting point and with the input of our landscape architect, consultant Charlie O’Leary, and horticulturalist Cornelia Creedon, we can draw plans and mood boards, suggest plants, textures, materials and ideas, and our landscaping team can implement those plans completely tailored for your satisfaction.  
  
At the Pavilion you will also discover a wonderful cafe where food is made fresh every day in our kitchens. We use locally sourced fresh ingredients where possible. We bake our bread & scones bright and early every morning so they’re almost still warm when you get them. Our salads are prepared from the mornings fruit and veg delivery and their dressings are all individual to the salad they accompany. Our cakes & treats are baked from scratch in our own kitchen and we believe that standard & consistency is paramount to maintain the quality of our cakes so that you always get the same delicious bite!  
  
We believe that the same values of quality and integrity should be reflected in everything we do - whether its the products we supply, the food we serve or the plants we grow. You will always understand the standard to expect from us to your our customer.

About New Mountain Capital
--------------------------

New Mountain Capital (“New Mountain”) is an alternative investment manager with private equity, credit and net lease strategies. New Mountain’s aggregate assets under management total over $37 billion across all investment strategies.\* Since inception, New Mountain has raised over $27 billion of committed capital across six private equity funds. New Mountain was founded in 1999 by Steven B. Klinsky and today has ~215 employees, ~130 of which are investment professionals.  
  
New Mountain’s efforts emphasize intensive fundamental research and a focus on growth and investor “value added,” rather than reliance on excessive risk, as the best path to high and consistent long-term returns. New Mountain has proactively developed particular research and operational expertise in carefully selected “defensive growth” niches of healthcare, health tech, life science supplies/biomanufacturing, “must have” information and data, digital marketing & transformation, infrastructure services/field services, specialized software, defensive growth consumer/products, financial services / technologies and technology-enabled business services. New Mountain Capital works systematically to establish expertise in additional sectors over time.  
  
\* Includes asset valuations and remaining commitments (if applicable) as of September 30, 2022 and includes undrawn capital for NMP VI as of September 30, 2022.

About The Columbus Organization

The Columbus Organization empowers individuals to realize their meaningful-life goals through nationally recognized care coordination (A.K.A. Case Management or Support Coordination), professional clinical staffing, and quality improvement services for the intellectual/developmental disability (I/DD) or behavioral needs community. Leveraging an unmatched depth of expertise, breadth of resources, diversity of thinking, and dedication to finding the most appropriate, personalized solutions for clients, The Columbus Organization provides a wide array of services specifically for families, individuals and the organizations that support them.  
  
The Columbus Organization is the nation’s leading provider of on-site professional staffing and consultative services, focusing exclusively on agencies that serve individuals with special needs. Since 1984, Columbus has assisted more than 140 state and local agencies in over 40 states and the District of Columbia to help solve staffing and programmatic problems. Many of these agencies faced challenging regulatory, certification, and litigation issues. In every instance, Columbus achieved positive outcomes. Columbus is an organization of professionals who have extensive expertise in clinical practice, recruiting professional staff, clinical research, staff training, forensic issues, litigation issues, and developing policies and procedures for agencies servicing individuals with special needs. Columbus has designed high-quality services that meet and exceed customers’ expectations, achieving improved outcomes within identified time frames and fiscal parameters.

About Wachusett Country Club
----------------------------

In 1927, a group of Worcester businessmen engaged the services of famous golf course architect, Donald Ross, to design a golf course that was to be known as Wachusett Country Club. The chosen site was the former Frost Farm in West Boylston, MA. However, few saw the dark clouds of the Great Depression gathering on the horizon. In 1939, Wachusett was taken over by its creditors and Joseph Marrone, a successful Worcester entrepreneur, took control of the deteriorating business and began what was to become a successful family business that would continue through four generations. After Joe's death in 1969, the three Marrone boys continued to uphold Wachusett's impeccable reputation while encountering several challenges along the way including a fire that destroyed most of the clubhouse in 1972. However, the clubhouse was rebuilt quickly and the successful business continued. When both Edward and Richard died in their early 50's, Donald took over the helm of Wachusett and worked for the next 20 years side by side with his son Donald Jr. cultivating and nurturing the golf course which was to them much more than just a business. Today, Don Jr. continues to run Wachusett with his four children who were instilled with the same belief that dedication and hard work are essential in continuing Wachusett's success.

Bienvenido a Bestway Global Holding Inc. Nuestra compañía se encarga del desarrollo, la producción y la venta de productos de deporte y ocio innovadores y de alta calidad. Nuestra gama cubre un abundante número de artículos diferentes para satisfacer las necesidades de todo tipo de personas: desde tablas de surf, piscinas elevadas e hidromasajes y colchones hinchables, hasta lanchas neumáticas y los productos de piscina hinchables más comunes.  
  
En Bestway creemos que la satisfacción permanente del cliente es el principio de la longevidad de la compañía, conseguida mediante nuestro modelo de negocio verticalmente integrado para la producción de los artículos más rentables para todo tipo de consumidores.

Fundada en 1994, Bestway (Bestway Global Holding) se especializa en la cadena de suministro de productos hinchables para el ocio, productos acuáticos deportivos, piscinas elevadas y otros artículos para el ocio al aire libre. Con un funcionamiento verticalmente integrado, Bestway se dedica a la Investigación y al Desarrollo, a la Fabricación, a las Ventas y a la Logística, representando actualmente alrededor del 25% del mercado internacional del sector.

About Applied Medical
---------------------

As a new generation medical device company, Applied Medical is focused on meeting three fundamental healthcare needs: enhanced clinical outcomes, cost containment and unrestricted choice. Our vertically integrated programs in design, development, manufacturing, and distribution enable us to consistently meet these objectives. As a vertically integrated company, we manufacture all of our products in-house at our corporate headquarters in Rancho Santa Margarita, California, and our European headquarters in Amersfoort, Netherlands with distribution centers around the world.  
  
Applied manufactures surgical devices for a wide range of medical specialties. Each year, Applied dedicates, on average, 20% of our revenue to product development and projects that increase the efficiency of our manufacturing operations. As such, we are able to fuel the continuous development of new surgical technologies.  
  
Applied is proud to have a significant and sustainable impact on healthcare. We address patient needs with advanced technologies that enhance surgical outcomes while also meeting our customers’ pressing economic needs.  
  
Applied team members are part of one of the fastest growing and most progressive organizations in the healthcare field. We are proud to have a culture strongly committed to ethical business practices, mutual respect, teamwork, and caring about our customers and our community.  
  
Applied's team members come from a wide range of experience, and their perspectives are crucial to the continued success of our organization. Applied respects each team member’s opinion and fosters a culture of open communication across all levels and departments.  
  
We are looking for exceptional people who share in our mission to deliver breakthrough technologies that enhance surgical and clinical care. We seek creative problem-solvers from a variety of career paths and backgrounds who are interested in making a meaningful, positive difference.

About İSF Entegre tesisi yönetim hizmetleri
-------------------------------------------

İnsan, mekân, hizmet ve teknoloji etkenlerini bütünleştirerek yapıların yaşam kalitesi ve kullanım kolaylıklarını arttıran bir hizmet mesleğidir. Ağır hizmetler olarak nitelendirilen hukuki, ticari ve teknik hizmetler yanında hafif hizmetler olarak kabul edilen güvenlik, temizlik, çevre zararlı mücadele gibi hizmetlere kadar bir yapının işleyişinde olması gereken hizmet yelpazesinin tamamını tedarik edip, yönetilmesi için gerekli hizmetin taşınmaz mal sahiplerine sunulmasıdır.  
Profesyonel Tesis Yönetim Hizmeti Kullanımının Gereklilik ve Faydaları,  
Malikler, enerjilerini ve zamanlarını bütünüyle ana faaliyet konularına veya başka konulara ayırabilecektir. Tesis Yönetimi, Tesis Yönetim Şirketlerinin ana faaliyet konusudur. Konusunu tam zamanlı ve profesyonel kadrolar ile yürüterek; Maliyet düşürme, yüksek standartta hizmet verme, müşteri memnuniyeti sağlama açısından rasyonel çözümler üretirler. Sektörde geniş mukayese (benchmarking) olanağına sahip olduklarından hizmet ve hizmetin maliyetindeki değişim ve gelişimi yakından takip edebilmekte ve giderleri optimize edebilmektedirler. Birçok farklı kuruluşa da hizmet verdiklerinden, müşterilerini sahip oldukları ölçek ekonomisinden yararlandırabilmekte, dolayısıyla buna yönelik maliyet avantajlarından faydalandırabilmektedir.  
Hedeflerden biri de maliyet düşürme olduğu için, profesyonel bir şirket maliyet arttırıcı bir unsur değil tam tersi olarak bütün tesis giderlerinde tasarrufa da yol açabilir. Tabi planlama ve beklentiler önemlidir. Tesis yönetiminde ve konusunda uzman personel havuzu vardır, esnek istihdam çözümleri sunar. Hizmet alan kuruluşu uzman kadroların temin edilmesi ile ilgili sıkıntılarından ve katlanmak zorunda kaldıkları nispeten yüksek istihdam maliyetlerinden kurtarır.

What services does The Difference provide to support vulnerable children?

The Difference focuses on improving life outcomes for vulnerable children by enhancing the skills and expertise of educators. Our services include tailored teacher training programs, consultancy on educational policy, and support for alternative provision settings. We work closely with schools and educational institutions to implement effective strategies that cater to the unique needs of at-risk students.

How does The Difference approach teacher training?

Our teacher training programs are designed to equip educators with the necessary skills to effectively support vulnerable children. We offer workshops, online courses, and one-on-one coaching that focus on trauma-informed practices, inclusive teaching strategies, and behavioral management techniques. Our goal is to empower teachers to create a nurturing and effective learning environment for all students.

What is alternative provision, and how does The Difference support it?

Alternative provision refers to educational settings that provide tailored learning experiences for children who may not thrive in traditional school environments. The Difference supports these settings by offering specialized training for educators, resources for curriculum development, and guidance on best practices for engaging and supporting vulnerable students. We aim to ensure that all children have access to quality education, regardless of their circumstances.

In which industries does The Difference operate?

The Difference primarily operates within the education sector, focusing on schools, alternative provision settings, and educational policy organizations. We collaborate with local authorities, non-profits, and community organizations to address the challenges faced by vulnerable children and to promote effective educational practices across various contexts.

How can schools partner with The Difference for training and support?

Schools interested in partnering with The Difference can reach out through our website to schedule an initial consultation. We will assess the specific needs of the school and tailor our training and support services accordingly. Our collaborative approach ensures that we work together to create impactful solutions that enhance the educational experiences of vulnerable children.

What impact has The Difference had on vulnerable children's education?

The Difference has made significant strides in improving educational outcomes for vulnerable children by empowering educators and enhancing teaching practices. Our initiatives have led to increased engagement in classrooms, improved academic performance, and better emotional well-being among students. By focusing on the professional development of teachers, we are fostering a more inclusive and supportive educational landscape for all children.

About Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange
--------------------------------------

With 1.3 million Catholics and 62 parishes and centers across Orange County, the Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange is among the largest and most diverse faith communities in the U.S.  
  
Our community is on a journey of faith together, growing closer to God and closer to one another as we explore, experience and share the mystery of Christ and the love of our Lord.  
  
Our vision is to establish and support dynamic, vibrant parishes and schools which welcome all to live the Gospel with faith, joy, charity and unity. Our Diocese encourages each person to have an active life of faith that is integrated and woven into the fabric of their daily lives through the community and sacramental life of the Catholic Church.  
  
The Diocese of Orange is headquartered at the Christ Cathedral Campus in Garden Grove, Calif.  
  
Job openings are advertised and updated frequently on the Diocese of Orange's Career Opportunities page at

What educational services does the Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange provide?

The Roman Catholic Diocese of Orange offers a comprehensive K-12 education system that includes a network of elementary and high schools. These institutions focus on academic excellence, spiritual growth, and character development, integrating Catholic values into their curricula. The diocese also provides resources for educators and families to support faith-based learning.

How does the Diocese support youth ministry programs?

The Diocese of Orange actively supports youth ministry through various programs designed to engage young people in their faith. This includes retreats, service opportunities, and leadership training. The diocese also provides resources and training for youth ministers to help them effectively connect with and guide the youth in their parishes.

What initiatives are in place for Hispanic ministry within the Diocese?

The Diocese of Orange recognizes the importance of serving its diverse community, particularly the Hispanic population. It offers specialized programs and resources tailored to Hispanic Catholics, including bilingual Masses, cultural celebrations, and faith formation classes. The diocese also focuses on leadership development within the Hispanic community to foster active participation in parish life.

What types of adult ministry programs are available?

The Diocese provides a variety of adult ministry programs aimed at fostering spiritual growth and community engagement. These include Bible study groups, faith-sharing sessions, and workshops on topics such as marriage, family life, and social justice. The diocese encourages adults to deepen their faith and become active participants in their parishes.

How does the Diocese address social justice and peace issues?

The Office of Justice & Peace within the Diocese of Orange is dedicated to promoting social justice and advocating for the marginalized. The diocese engages in various initiatives, including community outreach, educational programs on social teachings, and partnerships with local organizations to address issues such as poverty, immigration, and environmental stewardship.

What resources are available for parish operations and administration?

The Diocese of Orange provides extensive support for parish operations through its Diocesan Administration. This includes guidance on financial management, human resources, and compliance with church regulations. The diocese also offers training and resources to help parishes effectively manage their operations and enhance their community outreach efforts.
